national_questions.qe: What is the total financial outlay approved by the Union Government for the notified Semicon 2.0 scheme?
national_questions.qh: केंद्र सरकार द्वारा अधिसूचित 'सेमीकॉन 2.0' (Semicon 2.0) योजना के लिए कुल कितना वित्तीय परिव्यय स्वीकृत किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology notified the Semicon 2.0 scheme with an outlay of Rs 1.27 lakh crore across six pillars to integrate India into global semiconductor manufacturing.
• Option B is Incorrect because Rs 76,000 crore was the financial outlay under the initial Semicon 1.0 program.
• Option C is Incorrect because Rs 2.00 lakh crore is not the approved outlay for Semicon 2.0.
• Option D is Incorrect because Rs 95,000 crore is an inaccurate allocation figure.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first indigenous AI-powered process-safety and consequence-modelling platform launched for industrial hazards?
national_questions.qh: औद्योगिक जोखिमों के लिए शुरू किए गए भारत के पहले स्वदेशी एआई-संचालित प्रोसेस-सेफ्टी और कॉन्सिक्वेंस-मॉडलिंग प्लेटफॉर्म का नाम क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because AgniKawach is India's first indigenous AI-integrated process-safety and consequence-modelling platform designed to simulate industrial hazards across sectors like green hydrogen, LNG, and petrochemicals.
• Option A is Incorrect because AgniNet is not the safety platform created for industrial consequence modelling.
• Option B is Incorrect because SurakshaAI is not the designated name of this platform.
• Option C is Incorrect because VayuRakshak is an incorrect option.

national_questions.qe: India recently rejected a ruling regarding the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty issued by which international dispute settlement body based in The Hague?
national_questions.qh: भारत ने हाल ही में द हेग में स्थित किस अंतरराष्ट्रीय विवाद समाधान निकाय द्वारा 1960 की सिंधु जल संधि पर दिए गए निर्णय को खारिज कर दिया?
oe: International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes
oh: स्थायी मध्यस्थता न्यायालय (Permanent Court of Arbitration)
निवेश विवादों के निपटारे का अंतरराष्ट्रीय केंद्र (ICSID)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India rejected the ruling of the World Bank-constituted Permanent Court of Arbitration (PCA) in The Hague, maintaining that the court lacked jurisdiction and violated provisions of the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty.
• Option B is Incorrect because the ruling was issued by the Court of Arbitration, not the International Court of Justice (ICJ).
• Option C is Incorrect because ICSID handles investor-state dispute settlement, not bilateral water treaties.
• Option D is Incorrect because the UN International Law Commission is a legal drafting body, not an arbitration tribunal.

national_questions.qe: Under which central government initiative is the indigenous cardiac pacemaker chip 'iPACE-CHIP' being developed by researchers at IIT Jammu?
national_questions.qh: IIT जम्मू के शोधकर्ताओं द्वारा स्वदेशी कार्डिएक पेसमेकर चिप 'iPACE-CHIP' का विकास किस केंद्रीय योजना के तहत किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the indigenous 'iPACE-CHIP' pacemaker chip is being developed at IIT Jammu's IC-ResQ Lab under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology's Chips to Start-up (C2S) Programme.
• Option A is Incorrect because the National Quantum Mission targets quantum computing and communication systems.
• Option B is Incorrect because Semiconductor India Mission is the broader umbrella program, whereas C2S is the specific capacity-building initiative for chip design.
• Option C is Incorrect because Make in India Healthcare Initiative is a general sectoral banner, not the specific funding scheme for this chip design project.

national_questions.qe: Which satellite launched by ISRO using GSLV-F17 represents India's first imaging satellite deployed into a Sub-Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (Sub-GTO)?
national_questions.qh: GSLV-F17 द्वारा इसरो द्वारा प्रक्षेपित कौन सा उपग्रह सब-जियोसिंक्रोनस ट्रांसफर ऑर्बिट (Sub-GTO) में स्थापित भारत का पहला इमेजिंग उपग्रह है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because EOS-05 is India's first imaging satellite positioned in a Sub-Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (Sub-GTO), launched aboard GSLV-F17 from Sriharikota.
• Option A is Incorrect because EOS-03 was an earlier earth observation satellite launched in 2021.
• Option C is Incorrect because RISAT-1B is a radar imaging satellite operating in low earth orbit.
• Option D is Incorrect because INSAT-3DS is a dedicated meteorological satellite, not a Sub-GTO hyper-spectral imaging satellite.

national_questions.qe: In which premier technical institute has India's first fully residential postgraduate program in Artificial Intelligence and Agentic AI Engineering been launched on campus?
national_questions.qh: किस प्रमुख तकनीकी संस्थान परिसर में भारत का पहला पूर्णतः आवासीय स्नातकोत्तर कार्यक्रम (AI एवं एजेंटिक AI इंजीनियरिंग) शुरू किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because IIT Gandhinagar, Gujarat, launched India's first residential Postgraduate Diploma in AI-ML & Agentic AI Engineering delivered entirely on an IIT campus, aimed at preparing students for Forward Deployed Engineering roles.
• Option A is Incorrect because IIT Delhi is not the institute launching this specific residential postgraduate diploma in Agentic AI.
• Option C is Incorrect because IIT Madras offers various online and data science degrees, but this specific on-campus PG diploma was launched by IIT Gandhinagar.
• Option D is Incorrect because IIT Bombay is not associated with this milestone program.

national_questions.qe: Who appointed Retd Air Marshal Jeetendra Mishra as the first CEO of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Kshetra Trust?
national_questions.qh: श्री राम जन्मभूमि क्षेत्र ट्रस्ट के पहले सीईओ के रूप में रिटायर्ड एयर मार्शल जीतेंद्र मिश्रा को किसने नियुक्त किया?
oe: A three‑member search committee headed by retired Justice Pramod Kohli
oh: सेवानिवृत्त न्यायाधीश प्रमोद कोहली के नेतृत्व में तीन सदस्यीय खोज समिति
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the appointment was made by a three‑member search committee chaired by retired Justice Pramod Kohli.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Prime Minister did not directly appoint the CEO.
• Option B is Incorrect; the President’s role is ceremonial in such appointments.
• Option C is Incorrect; while the Ministry of Home Affairs oversees the trust, the specific appointment was through the search committee.

national_questions.qe: What base year was adopted for the revised GDP series released by the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation in 2026?
national_questions.qh: 2026 में MoSPI द्वारा जारी किए गए संशोधित जीडीपी श्रृंखला के लिए कौन सा बेस वर्ष अपनाया गया?
national_questions.e:

• Option B is Incorrect because 2021‑22 was the previous base year, not the one adopted in 2026.
• Option C is Incorrect because 2020‑21 is not mentioned in the release.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2023‑24 was not yet a base year at the time of the announcement.

national_questions.qe: Ahmedabad airport became the third Indian airport to join which government aviation initiative?
national_questions.qh: अहमदाबाद हवाई अड्डा भारत का तीसरा हवाई अड्डा बनकर किस सरकारी एयरोस्पेस पहल में शामिल हुआ?
national_questions.e:

• Option A is Incorrect as RCS (UDAN) is a separate regional connectivity programme.
• Option C is Incorrect because UDAN pertains to domestic connectivity, not the Hub‑&‑Spoke international framework.
• Option D is Incorrect; Bharat Gati Shakti relates to multi‑modal logistics, not aviation hub policy.

national_questions.qe: The PM Dhan‑Dhaanya Krishi Yojana converges how many central schemes across ministries?
national_questions.qh: पीएम धान‑धान्य कृषि योजना किन मंत्रालयों में कुल कितनी केंद्रीय योजनाओं को एकीकृत करती है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the scheme integrates 36 central schemes spanning 11 ministries and departments.
• Option A is Incorrect; 24 schemes are not the figure cited in the official review.
• Option B is Incorrect; 30 schemes are lower than the actual count.
• Option D is Incorrect; 42 schemes exceed the announced number.

national_questions.qe: Under which article of the Constitution did the Supreme Court quash FIRs against protesting students in July 2024?
national_questions.qh: जुलाई 2024 में छात्रों के विरोध के खिलाफ दर्ज FIR को निरस्त करने के लिए सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद का प्रयोग किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the bench invoked the special powers under Article 142 to direct the quashing of nationwide FIRs.
• Option A is Incorrect; Article 32 deals with the right to constitutional remedies, not judicial directives of this nature.
• Option B is Incorrect; Article 136 pertains to the Supreme Court’s advisory jurisdiction.
• Option C is Incorrect; Article 141 relates to the doctrine of precedent, not to the power used here.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first geosynchronous Earth‑observation imaging satellite launched on GSLV‑F17?
national_questions.qh: GSLV‑F17 द्वारा प्रक्षेपित भारत का पहला भू‑सिंक्रोनस पृथ्वी‑पर्यवेक्षण इमेजिंग उपग्रह कौन सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because EOS‑05 is the first Indian Earth‑observation imaging satellite intended for a geosynchronous orbit, launched aboard GSLV‑F17 on 4 September 2026.
• Option B is Incorrect; Cartosat‑3 is a high‑resolution optical satellite in low‑Earth orbit.
• Option C is Incorrect; RISAT‑2B is a radar‑imaging satellite in low‑Earth orbit.
• Option D is Incorrect; GSAT‑30 is a communication satellite in geostationary orbit, not an imaging payload.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state launched the country's first state‑level Sports Genomics Programme?
national_questions.qh: भारत में पहला राज्य‑स्तरीय स्पोर्ट्स जीनोमिक्स प्रोग्राम किस राज्य ने शुरू किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Gujarat, through the Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre under DST, launched the first Sports Genomics Programme, aiming to build a genome database of athletes.
• Option A is Incorrect; Maharashtra has sports initiatives but not the first genomics programme.
• Option B is Incorrect; Karnataka focuses on biotech research but has not launched this specific programme.
• Option D is Incorrect; Tamil Nadu has sports schemes but not the inaugural state‑level genomics programme.

national_questions.qe: Who became the first woman officer from the non‑medical branch of the Indian Armed Forces to be promoted to the rank of Air Vice Marshal?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय सशस्त्र बलों की गैर‑चिकित्सा शाखा से पहली महिला अधिकारी कौन बनीं, जिन्हें एयर वाइस मार्शल की उपाधि मिली?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Air Vice Marshal Shakti Sharma was promoted on 1 September 2026, becoming the first woman from the non‑medical branch to attain this rank and appointed Assistant Chief of the Air Staff (Education).
• Option A is Incorrect; Nivedita Sharma is a senior officer but has not achieved this historic milestone.
• Option C is Incorrect; Anjali Singh holds a different rank.
• Option D is Incorrect; Priya Kumar is not the first non‑medical woman officer at this rank.

national_questions.qe: Which state has launched India's first state‑led electric truck corridor on National Highway 66?
national_questions.qh: कौन से राज्य ने राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग 66 पर भारत का पहला राज्य‑प्रमुख इलेक्ट्रिक ट्रक कॉरिडोर शुरू किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB) is leading the project to set up India's first electric truck corridor on the 622 km stretch of NH 66 in Kerala, requiring 12.5 MW charging capacity and an investment of Rs 19 crore with 207 fast‑charging stations.
• Option B is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu has not announced a state‑led electric truck corridor on NH 66.
• Option C is Incorrect because Karnataka is not the state mentioned in the announcement.
• Option D is Incorrect because Maharashtra is not involved in this specific corridor project.

national_questions.qe: India's Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) signed a Memorandum of Understanding to strengthen cooperation against cybercrime and transnational crime with the Federal Police of which country?
national_questions.qh: भारत के केंद्रीय अन्वेषण ब्यूरो (CBI) ने साइबर अपराध और अंतरराष्ट्रीय अपराध से निपटने में सहयोग बढ़ाने के लिए किस देश की संघीय पुलिस के साथ समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the CBI signed an MoU with the Federal Police of Belgium to combat cybercrime and transnational crime during the launch of the India-Belgium Strategic Dialogue.
• Option B is Incorrect because France was not the nation signing this specific law enforcement agreement during the dialogue.
• Option C is Incorrect because Germany shares intelligence through Interpol channels rather than this bilateral deal.
• Option D is Incorrect because Australia's police cooperation agreements with India fall under a different treaty mechanism.

national_questions.qe: Which strategic framework document was recently unveiled by the Union Defence Minister to serve as a 10-year roadmap for India's global defence diplomacy?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में केंद्रीय रक्षा मंत्री द्वारा भारत की वैश्विक रक्षा कूटनीति के लिए 10-वर्षीय रोडमैप के रूप में किस रणनीतिक रूपरेखा दस्तावेज का अनावरण किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Defence Minister unveiled 'RAKSHA', a comprehensive strategic framework document laying out India's 10-year roadmap for global defence diplomacy and partnerships.
• Option B is Incorrect because SURAKSHA is a general security term and not the title of this 10-year strategic roadmap.
• Option C is Incorrect because KAVACH is the indigenous Automatic Train Protection system developed by Indian Railways.
• Option D is Incorrect because SAMARTH is a flagship scheme for capacity building and skill development under the Ministry of Textiles.

national_questions.qe: On which river basin is the proposed 1,856 MW Sawalkot Hydroelectric Project located in Jammu & Kashmir?
national_questions.qh: जम्मू और कश्मीर में स्थित 1,856 मेगावाट की प्रस्तावित सावलकोट जलविद्युत परियोजना किस नदी बेसिन पर स्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the 1,856 MW Sawalkot Hydroelectric Project is located on the Chenab River basin across Ramban, Udhampur, and Reasi districts of Jammu & Kashmir.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Jhelum basin houses projects like Uri and Kishanganga, not Sawalkot.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Ravi basin includes projects such as the Chamera and Thein (Ranjit Sagar) dams.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Satluj basin features major infrastructure like the Bhakra Nangal and Nathpa Jhakri projects.

national_questions.qe: Which nodal body under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry implements the 'Districts as Export Hubs' (DEH) initiative across Indian districts?
national_questions.qh: वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्रालय के तहत कौन सा नोडल निकाय भारतीय जिलों में 'डिस्ट्रिक्ट्स एज एक्सपोर्ट हब्स' (DEH) पहल का कार्यान्वयन करता है?
oe: Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA)
oh: कृषि और प्रसंस्कृत खाद्य उत्पाद निर्यात विकास प्राधिकरण (APEDA)
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) under the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, serves as the main implementing body for the 'Districts as Export Hubs' (DEH) initiative.

• Option D is Incorrect because APEDA specifically targets the export development of scheduled agricultural and processed food products.

national_questions.qe: Which sail training ship of the Indian Navy is undertaking the 10-month transoceanic expedition named 'Lokayan 2026'?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय नौसेना का कौन सा नौकायन प्रशिक्षण पोत 'लोकायन 2026' नामक 10 महीने के ट्रांस-ओशनिक अभियान पर है?

• Option A is Incorrect because while INS Tarangini is also a sail training ship, it is INS Sudarshini that was deployed for Lokayan 2026.
• Option B is Incorrect because INS Mhadei is a sail training vessel notable for circumnavigation voyages.

national_questions.qe: What is the official theme of the 11th Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit organized in Gandhinagar?
national_questions.qh: गांधीनगर में आयोजित होने वाले 11वें वाइब्रेंट गुजरात वैश्विक शिखर सम्मेलन का आधिकारिक विषय (थीम) क्या है?

national_questions.e:

• Option B is Incorrect because it is a general framing not associated with the summit's official tagline.
• Option C is Incorrect because while green energy and semiconductors are key focus sectors, they do not form the main theme.
• Option D is Incorrect because it is a generic summit slogan.

national_questions.qe: Which launch vehicle was used by ISRO to launch EOS-05, India's first Earth observation satellite placed in a geosynchronous orbit?
national_questions.qh: भू-तुल्यकालिक कक्षा (Geosynchronous Orbit) में स्थापित किए जाने वाले भारत के पहले अर्थ ऑब्जर्वेशन सैटेलाइट EOS-05 को प्रक्षेपित करने के लिए ISRO द्वारा किस रॉकेट का उपयोग किया गया?

• Option A is Incorrect because PSLV-C58 was utilized for launching the XPoSAT mission.
• Option C is Incorrect because LVM3-M4 was used to launch Chandrayaan-3.
• Option D is Incorrect because SSLV-D2 was used for launching EOS-07.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian city was selected to host India’s first Hyundai World Archery Para Series along the Sabarmati Riverfront?
national_questions.qh: साबरमती रिवरफ्रंट के किनारे भारत की पहली 'हुंडई वर्ल्ड आर्चरी पैरा सीरीज' आयोजित करने के लिए किस भारतीय शहर को चुना गया है?
national_questions.e:

• Option A is Incorrect because Gandhinagar is the state capital, not the event venue.
• Option B is Incorrect because Surat is not the host location.
• Option D is Incorrect because Vadodara is not hosting this international para-archery event.

national_questions.qe: Which state has proposed India’s first state-led dedicated electric truck corridor spanning 622 km along National Highway 66?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग 66 के किनारे 622 किमी लंबे भारत के पहले राज्य-नेतृत्व वाले समर्पित इलेक्ट्रिक ट्रक कॉरिडोर का प्रस्ताव किस राज्य द्वारा रखा गया है?

• Option B is Incorrect because Tamil Nadu is not the proposing state authority.

national_questions.qe: Which satellite is India’s first imaging satellite to operate from a geosynchronous orbit, launched on GSLV‑F17?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा उपग्रह भारत का पहला इमेजिंग उपग्रह है जो भूस्थिर कक्षा में कार्य करता है और GSLV‑F17 से लॉन्च किया गया?
national_questions.e:

• Option B is Incorrect because GSAT‑30 is a communication satellite, not an imaging payload.
• Option C is Incorrect because Cartosat‑3 operates in a low‑Earth orbit.

national_questions.qh: कौन से अस्पताल ने भारत में पहली बार पल्स्ड फील्ड एब्लेशन और लेफ्ट एट्रियल अपेंडेज़ ऑक्लूज़न प्रक्रिया का संयुक्त रूप से संचालन किया?
oe: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, New Delhi
oh: ऑल इंडिया इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ मेडिकल साइंसेज़, नई दिल्ली
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Lilavati Hospital, Mumbai performed the first combined Pulsed Field Ablation (PFA) for atrial fibrillation and Left Atrial Appendage Occlusion (LAAO) on 14 August 2026.

• Option C is Incorrect because Apollo Hospital Chennai has not reported this specific combined intervention.
• Option D is Incorrect because Fortis Hospital Bangalore has not reported this combined procedure.

national_questions.qe: The 'NAMASTE' scheme, which provides formal recognition, social security, and health benefits to sanitation workers and waste pickers, is implemented by which Union Ministry?
national_questions.qh: स्वच्छता कर्मचारियों और कचरा बीनने वालों को औपचारिक पहचान, सामाजिक सुरक्षा और स्वास्थ्य लाभ प्रदान करने वाली 'नमस्ते' (NAMASTE) योजना किस केंद्रीय मंत्रालय द्वारा कार्यान्वित की जाती है?
oe: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

• Option D is Incorrect because Rural Development is not the administering authority for this sanitation mechanisation scheme.

national_questions.qe: India announced the appointment of a Defence Attaché to which European city following high-level bilateral talks focused on Trade, Technology, and Talent (3 Ts)?
national_questions.qh: व्यापार, प्रौद्योगिकी और प्रतिभा (3 Ts) पर केंद्रित उच्च स्तरीय द्विपक्षीय वार्ता के बाद भारत ने किस यूरोपीय शहर में रक्षा अताशे (Defence Attaché) नियुक्त करने की घोषणा की?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because India announced the appointment of a Defence Attaché to Brussels (Belgium) during Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever's visit to India.
• Option A is Incorrect because Berlin is the capital of Germany and not where this specific Defence Attaché was newly established under this bilateral summit.
• Option B is Incorrect because India already maintains existing defence representation in Paris, France.

national_questions.qe: Which institution hosted the 18th Meeting of the Heads of Intellectual Property (IP) Offices of BRICS Countries in New Delhi?
national_questions.qh: नई दिल्ली में आयोजित ब्रिक्स (BRICS) देशों के बौद्धिक संपदा (IP) कार्यालयों के प्रमुखों की 18वीं बैठक की मेजबानी किस संस्थान ने की?
oe: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)
Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)

national_questions.qe: Which international credit rating agency recently upgraded India's sovereign credit rating (Foreign and Local Currency Issuer Ratings) from 'BBB+' to 'A-' with a Stable Outlook?

national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Japan Credit Rating Agency (JCR) upgraded India’s sovereign rating from 'BBB+' to 'A-' with a Stable Outlook citing high economic growth and fiscal consolidation.
• Option A is Incorrect because S&P Global Ratings did not issue this upgrade.

national_questions.qe: Which payments bank launched dedicated digital platforms for mutual funds and insurance products on its 9th Foundation Day?
national_questions.qh: अपने 9वें स्थापना दिवस के अवसर पर किस पेमेंट्स बैंक ने म्यूचुअल फंड और बीमा उत्पादों के लिए समर्पित डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म लॉन्च किए?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) launched digital mutual fund and insurance platforms on its 9th Foundation Day to expand financial inclusion, leveraging its massive rural reach.
• Option A is Incorrect because Airtel Payments Bank was not the entity launching these comprehensive investment platforms on its 9th Foundation Day.
• Option B is Incorrect because Paytm Payments Bank is a private entity subject to regulatory curbs and not post-office-linked.
• Option C is Incorrect because Fino Payments Bank is a separate commercial entity.

national_questions.qe: What is the revised maximum stock holding limit imposed on sugar dealers by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs to curb speculative trading and maintain price stability?
national_questions.qh: सट्टेबाजी को रोकने और मूल्य स्थिरता बनाए रखने के लिए उपभोक्ता मामले मंत्रालय द्वारा चीनी व्यापारियों पर लगाई गई संशोधित अधिकतम स्टॉक भंडारण सीमा क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution reduced the stock holding limit for sugar dealers from 4,000 quintals to 2,000 quintals to prevent hoarding and ensure price stability.
• Option A is Incorrect because 1,000 quintals is lower than the newly fixed ceiling.
• Option B is Incorrect because 3,000 quintals is not the mandated limit.
• Option C is Incorrect because 5,000 quintals exceeds the previous ceiling of 4,000 quintals.

national_questions.qe: Where was the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors (FMCBG) meeting held, which was attended by Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman?
national_questions.qh: केंद्रीय वित्त मंत्री निर्मला सीतारमण की उपस्थिति में आयोजित G20 वित्त मंत्रियों और सेंट्रल बैंक गवर्नर्स (FMCBG) की बैठक किस स्थान पर संपन्न हुई?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman led the Indian delegation at the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors (FMCBG) meeting held in Asheville, US.
• Option B is Incorrect because Geneva did not host this G20 ministerial meeting.
• Option C is Incorrect because Hamburg was a previous G20 Leaders' Summit host.
• Option D is Incorrect because Toronto was not the venue for this conference.

national_questions.qe: Which launch vehicle was utilized by ISRO to place India's first dedicated imaging satellite in geosynchronous orbit, EOS-05?
national_questions.qh: भारत के भू-समकालिक कक्षा (Geosynchronous Orbit) में स्थापित पहले समर्पित इमेजिंग उपग्रह EOS-05 को प्रक्षेपित करने के लिए ISRO द्वारा किस रॉकेट का उपयोग किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because ISRO successfully launched EOS-05, India's first dedicated imaging satellite intended for geosynchronous orbit, using the GSLV-F17 launch vehicle from Sriharikota.
• Option A is Incorrect because PSLV-C58 was used for the XPoSat mission, not EOS-05.
• Option C is Incorrect because LVM3-M4 was the launch vehicle for Chandrayaan-3.
• Option D is Incorrect because SSLV-D3 is a small satellite launcher unfit for heavy geosynchronous payloads.

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India’s first imaging satellite placed in a geosynchronous orbit launched by ISRO on 3 September 2026?
national_questions.qh: भारत के प्रथम भू‑चित्रण उपग्रह का नाम क्या है, जिसे 3 सितंबर 2026 को इसरो ने भू‑स्थिर कक्षा में स्थापित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because EOS‑05 is the satellite launched by ISRO on GSLV‑F17 on 3 September 2026, marking India’s first dedicated imaging satellite in a geosynchronous orbit.
• Option B is Incorrect because GSAT‑30 is a communication satellite, not an imaging satellite.
• Option C is Incorrect because Cartosat‑3 is a low‑Earth‑orbit imaging satellite, not geosynchronous.
• Option D is Incorrect because RISAT‑2B is a radar imaging satellite in low‑Earth orbit.

national_questions.qe: Which launch vehicle was used to place EOS‑05 into a sub‑geosynchronous transfer orbit?
national_questions.qh: EOS‑05 को उप‑भू‑स्थिर ट्रांसफ़र कक्षा में स्थापित करने के लिए कौन सा प्रक्षेपण यान उपयोग किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the EOS‑05 mission was launched aboard the GSLV‑F17 rocket, the 19th flight of the GSLV series, inserting the satellite into a sub‑geosynchronous transfer orbit.
• Option A is Incorrect because PSLV is used for low‑Earth‑orbit missions, not for this heavy GSLV payload.
• Option C is Incorrect because GSLV Mk III (LVM3) is a different heavy‑lift vehicle; EOS‑05 used GSLV‑F17.
• Option D is Incorrect because LVM3 is another name for GSLV Mk III, not the vehicle employed for this launch.

national_questions.qe: What is the total investment allocated by Kerala State Electricity Board Ltd for setting up 200 fast electric‑vehicle charging stations on the 622‑km electric truck corridor on NH 66?
national_questions.qh: केरल राज्य विद्युत बोर्ड लिमिटेड द्वारा एनएच 66 पर 200 फास्ट ई‑वी चार्जिंग स्टेशन स्थापित करने के लिए कुल निवेश कितना निर्धारित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the project description states an investment of Rs 19 crore for the 200 fast‑charging stations on the 622‑km corridor.
• Option B is Incorrect because the figure is ten times higher than the announced amount.
• Option C is Incorrect because it understates the announced investment.
• Option D is Incorrect because it does not match any figure mentioned in the news.

national_questions.qe: Which launch vehicle is scheduled to place India’s first geosynchronous imaging satellite EOS‑05 into orbit on 4 September 2026?
national_questions.qh: 4 सितंबर 2026 को भारत के पहले जियोसिंक्रोनस इमेजिंग उपग्रह EOS‑05 को कक्षा में स्थापित करने के लिए कौन सा लॉन्च वाहन निर्धारित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because official ISRO releases state that EOS‑05 will be launched aboard GSLV‑F17 on 4 September 2026.
• Option A is Incorrect as PSLV‑C55 is a polar‑sun‑synchronous launch vehicle, not used for geosynchronous missions.
• Option C is Incorrect because GSLV‑MkIII (LVM3) is a different heavy‑lift vehicle and was not slated for this mission.
• Option D is Incorrect; LVM3 is another name for GSLV‑MkIII and not the vehicle mentioned for EOS‑05.

national_questions.qe: The 'CSS Shield' scheme provides a minimum financial assistance of how many rupees to the families of deceased Central Secretariat Service officers?
national_questions.qh: 'CSS Shield' योजना मृत केंद्रीय सचिवालय सेवा (CSS) अधिकारियों के परिवारों को न्यूनतम कितनी रुपये की वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करती है?
national_questions.e: • Option D is Correct because the scheme guarantees a minimum assistance of Rs 15 lakh to the families of deceased CSS officers. • Option A is Incorrect; the amount is higher than Rs 5 lakh. • Option B is Incorrect; the scheme specifies Rs 15 lakh, not Rs 10 lakh. • Option C is Incorrect; Rs 12 lakh is not the stipulated minimum assistance.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry launched the nationwide outreach programme to increase utilisation of India's Free Trade Agreements?
national_questions.qh: कौन से मंत्रालय ने भारत के मुक्त व्यापार समझौतों (FTA) के उपयोग को बढ़ाने के लिए राष्ट्रीय आउटरीच कार्यक्रम शुरू किया?
oe: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Union Minister Piyush Goyal, representing the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, inaugurated the 'Leveraging FTAs: An Outreach Programme' covering all 780 districts.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of External Affairs deals with diplomatic relations, not FTAs outreach.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Finance Ministry handles fiscal policy, not direct FTA utilisation drives.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Agriculture Ministry focuses on farm sector schemes, not the nationwide FTA outreach.

national_questions.qe: During the 2024 visit to Ukraine, what humanitarian assistance did India dispatch?
national_questions.qh: 2024 में यूक्रेन की यात्रा के दौरान भारत ने कौन सी मानवीय सहायता भेजी?
oe: 19 consignments totaling 160 tonnes, including generator sets, medicines and medical equipment
oh: 19 कंसाइनमेंट, कुल 160 टन, जिसमें जनरेटर सेट, दवाइयाँ और चिकित्सा उपकरण शामिल हैं
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because India sent 19 consignments weighing about 160 tonnes, comprising generator sets, medicines and medical equipment as stated by External Affairs Minister Dr S. Jaishankar.
• Option A is Incorrect because the aid consisted of medical and equipment supplies, not solely food.
• Option C is Incorrect because there was no mention of air‑dropped kits in the visit.
• Option D is Incorrect because the assistance was humanitarian, not military.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal agency for the defence cooperation dialogues between India and Belgium?
national_questions.qh: भारत और बेल्जियम के बीच रक्षा सहयोग संवादों के लिए कौन सा मंत्रालय मुख्य एजेंसी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the bilateral defence talks were held by Union Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and the cooperation dialogues are under the Ministry of Defence.
• Option B is Incorrect because external affairs handles diplomatic relations, not the specific defence dialogue.
• Option C is Incorrect because trade matters are not the primary nodal agency for defence cooperation.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Home Ministry deals with internal security, not international defence collaboration.

national_questions.qe: Which reform announced by the Finance Minister aims to ease port congestion by using scanners for risk‑based automatic import clearance?
national_questions.qh: वित्त मंत्री द्वारा घोषित कौन सा सुधार पोर्ट जाम को कम करने के लिए स्कैनर और जोखिम‑आधारित स्वचालित आयात मंजूरी का उपयोग करता है?
oe: Introduction of a new customs duty slab
Deployment of scanners for risk‑based automatic import clearance
Extension of GST to all imported goods
Abolition of import licensing for all commodities
oh: नए कस्टम ड्यूटी स्लैब का परिचय
जोखिम‑आधारित स्वचालित आयात मंजूरी के लिए स्कैनर की तैनाती
सभी आयातित वस्तुओं पर जीएसटी का विस्तार
सभी वस्तुओं के लिए आयात लाइसेंसिंग का उन्मूलन
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced scanner deployment and risk‑based automatic clearance to de‑congest ports.
• Option A is Incorrect as no new duty slab was part of the announcement.
• Option C is Incorrect; GST extension was not mentioned in the reforms.
• Option D is Incorrect; the reforms focus on facilitation, not removal of licensing.

national_questions.qe: What is the target capacity of the demonstration geothermal plant to be evaluated in Puga Valley, Ladakh?
national_questions.qh: पुगा वैली, लद्दाख में मूल्यांकन के लिए प्रस्तावित जियोथर्मल डेमो प्लांट की लक्ष्य क्षमता क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because ONGC Energy Centre plans to assess the reservoir for a 1 MW demonstration geothermal plant.
• Option A is Incorrect; 0.5 MW is not the stated target.
• Option B is Incorrect; 1 MW is the target, not an option here.
• Option D is Incorrect; 10 MW far exceeds the pilot project's scope.

national_questions.qe: From which launch vehicle was India's first imaging satellite for geosynchronous orbit, EOS‑05, launched?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले जियोसिंक्रोनस कक्षा के इमेजिंग उपग्रह EOS‑05 को किस लॉन्च वाहन से प्रक्षेपित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because EOS‑05 was launched on 4 September 2026 by GSLV‑F17, marking the first geosynchronous imaging satellite.
• Option A is Incorrect; PSLV‑C51 is used for LEO missions.
• Option B is Incorrect; GSLV‑Mk III‑F10 is a different flight.
• Option D is Incorrect; SSLV‑D2 is a small‑sat launch vehicle, not used for this mission.

national_questions.qe: Under which national policy were the first geothermal demonstration wells commissioned in Puga Valley, Ladakh?
national_questions.qh: पुगा वैली, लद्दाख में स्थापित प्रथम भू‑तापीय प्रदर्शन कुओं को किस राष्ट्रीय नीति के तहत कार्यान्वित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the two 1,000‑m deep wells in Puga Valley were commissioned by ONGC Energy Centre for reservoir evaluation under the National Policy on Geothermal Energy (2025).
• Option B is Incorrect because the Solar Mission deals with solar power, not geothermal resources.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Hydrogen Energy Mission is unrelated to geothermal drilling.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Biofuel Policy pertains to bio‑fuel production, not geothermal energy.

national_questions.qe: Which launch vehicle placed India’s first geosynchronous imaging satellite EOS‑05 into orbit?
national_questions.qh: भारत का पहला भू‑स्थिर (जियोसिंक्रोनस) इमेजिंग उपग्रह EOS‑05 को किस प्रक्षेपण यान ने अंतरिक्ष में स्थापित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because EOS‑05, weighing 2,367 kg, was launched on 4 Sept 2026 by ISRO using the GSLV‑F17 (19th GSLV flight), inserting the satellite into a sub‑geosynchronous transfer orbit before circularisation to GEO.
• Option A is Incorrect as PSLV‑C55 is a polar‑sun‑synchronous launch vehicle used for LEO missions, not for GEO payloads.
• Option C is Incorrect because LVM3‑M1 is another designation for the GSLV Mk III, but the specific flight used for EOS‑05 was labelled GSLV‑F17.
• Option D is Incorrect; although GSLV Mk III is the family, the mission’s official designation was GSLV‑F17, not simply “Mk III”.

national_questions.qe: Which launch vehicle was used to place India’s first geosynchronous Earth‑observation imaging satellite, EOS‑05, into orbit?
national_questions.qh: भारत के पहले जियोसिंक्रोनस पृथ्वी‑पर्यवेक्षण इमेजिंग उपग्रह EOS‑05 को कक्षा में स्थापित करने के लिए कौन सा लॉन्च वाहन उपयोग किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because EOS‑05 was launched on 3 Sept 2026 aboard ISRO’s GSLV‑F17 heavy‑lift vehicle from Satish Dhawan Space Centre.
• Option B is Incorrect as PSLV‑C55 is a polar‑satellite launch vehicle and was not used for this mission.
• Option C is Incorrect because GSLV‑MkIII (now called LVM3) is a different launch vehicle; the mission employed GSLV‑F17.
• Option D is Incorrect; LVM3 is the re‑branded name of GSLV‑MkIII and was not the launch vehicle for EOS‑05.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian state’s Lok Bhavan became the first to receive IGBC Platinum certification under the Green Campus v1 rating system?
national_questions.qh: कौन से भारतीय राज्य का लोक भवन IGBC प्लैटिनम प्रमाणन प्राप्त करने वाला पहला ग्रिन कैंपस v1 रेटिंग सिस्टम वाला कैंपस बना?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Odisha’s Lok Bhavan in Bhubaneswar earned the first IGBC Platinum rating under the revised Green Campus v1 system, scoring 88/100.
• Option A is Incorrect; Gujarat has not yet achieved the IGBC Platinum status for any Lok Bhavan.
• Option C is Incorrect; Karnataka’s Lok Bhavan has not been awarded the Platinum rating.
• Option D is Incorrect; Tamil Nadu’s Lok Bhavan also does not hold this certification.

national_questions.qe: In which city was the 16th National Meet of State Biodiversity Boards (SBBs) organized by the National Biodiversity Authority held?
national_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय जैव विविधता प्राधिकरण द्वारा राज्य जैव विविधता बोर्डों (SBBs) की 16वीं राष्ट्रीय बैठक किस शहर में आयोजित की गई?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) organized the 16th National Meet of State Biodiversity Boards (SBBs) and UT Biodiversity Councils in Chandigarh, emphasizing alignment with the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023.
• Option A is Incorrect because New Delhi was not the host city for this specific national meet of biodiversity boards.
• Option B is Incorrect because Bengaluru houses the headquarters of the National Biodiversity Authority, but it was not the venue for the 16th meet.
• Option D is Incorrect because Dehradun hosts major forestry institutes like FRI and WII, but was not the meeting location.

national_questions.qe: Which indigenously designed aircraft is operated by the Indian Air Force's 'Sarang' Helicopter Display Team?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय वायु सेना की 'सारंग' हेलीकॉप्टर प्रदर्शन टीम द्वारा किस स्वदेशी रूप से डिजाइन किए गए विमान का संचालन किया जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Indian Air Force's Sarang Helicopter Display Team operates the indigenously developed Advanced Light Helicopter (ALH) Dhruv, manufactured by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL).
• Option B is Incorrect because LCH Prachand is India's light combat attack helicopter, not the aircraft flown by the Sarang display team.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Light Utility Helicopter (LUH) is a single-engine utility craft, distinct from the twin-engine ALH Dhruv.
• Option D is Incorrect because Mi-17 V5 is a Russian-origin transport helicopter used by the IAF, not an indigenous display platform.

national_questions.qe: Which map projection did the United Nations General Assembly adopt in its 'Correct the Map' resolution to replace the traditional Mercator projection?
national_questions.qh: संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा ने अपने 'करेक्ट द मैप' प्रस्ताव में पारंपरिक मर्केटर प्रक्षेपण के स्थान पर किस मानचित्र प्रक्षेपण को अपनाने का प्रस्ताव पारित किया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the UN General Assembly adopted the resolution sponsored by Togo advocating the 2018 'Equal Earth projection' to accurately represent the relative proportions of continents over the distorted 1569 Mercator projection.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Robinson projection is an older compromised projection developed in 1963, not the modern standard adopted in this resolution.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Gall-Peters projection is an equal-area cylindrical projection, but was not selected in the UNGA resolution.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Winkel Tripel projection is used by organizations like National Geographic, but was not the subject of the UN proposal.

national_questions.qe: Which country's Prime Minister recently undertook the first official bilateral visit to India by its head of government in two decades, focusing on strengthening the Antwerp-Mumbai trade corridor?
national_questions.qh: किस देश के प्रधानमंत्री ने हाल ही में दो दशकों में अपने सरकार के प्रमुख की पहली आधिकारिक भारत यात्रा की, जिसका मुख्य उद्देश्य एंटवर्प-मुंबई व्यापार गलियारे को मजबूत करना था?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Prime Minister Bart De Wever of Belgium made an official visit to India, marking the first visit by a Belgian Prime Minister in two decades. The bilateral relationship is heavily anchored by the global diamond trade connecting Antwerp and Mumbai.
• Option A is Incorrect because Luxembourg's head of government did not undertake this visit.
• Option C is Incorrect because Netherlands was not the nation making this historic two-decade milestone visit.
• Option D is Incorrect because Switzerland is not associated with this bilateral visit.

national_questions.qe: India's first commercial hydrogen-powered passenger train has been launched by Indian Railways to operate on which rail route?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय रेलवे द्वारा भारत की पहली व्यावसायिक हाइड्रोजन-संचालित यात्री ट्रेन को किस रेल मार्ग पर संचालित करने के लिए शुरू किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Indian Railways launched India's first commercial hydrogen-powered train on the 89-km Jind–Sonipat route in Haryana, operating at an operational speed of 110 kmph.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Pathankot–Joginder Nagar narrow-gauge section was not chosen for this inaugural hydrogen train service.
• Option B is Incorrect because Kalka–Shimla is a historic UNESCO heritage railway line.
• Option D is Incorrect because Darjeeling–Ghum is part of the Darjeeling Himalayan Railway.

national_questions.qe: India's first population census to be conducted using digital tools and self-enumeration portals is scheduled to commence nationally from which date?
national_questions.qh: डिजिटल उपकरणों और स्व-गणना पोर्टल का उपयोग करके आयोजित की जाने वाली भारत की पहली जनसंख्या जनगणना देश भर में किस तिथि से शुरू होने वाली है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because India's first digital population census is scheduled to begin nationwide on March 1, 2027, deployed by the Office of the Registrar General under the Ministry of Home Affairs using dedicated digital applications like CMMS and HLBC.
• Option B is Incorrect because January 26, 2026 is not the officially announced start date for the digital census.
• Option C is Incorrect because October 2, 2026 is factually incorrect.
• Option D is Incorrect because August 15, 2027 is not the scheduled commencement date.

national_questions.qe: Where is India's first dedicated AI Innovation City being developed with a planned investment of $11 billion?
national_questions.qh: 11 बिलियन डॉलर के अनुमानित निवेश से भारत का पहला समर्पित AI इनोवेशन सिटी किस स्थान के समीप विकसित किया जा रहा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: India's first dedicated AI Innovation City is being fast-tracked across a 300-acre site near the Navi Mumbai International Airport in Maharashtra, with an investment of $11 billion to house data centres, semiconductor facilities, and high-performance computing.
• Option B is Incorrect: Bengaluru is a recognized IT hub but is not the location for this 300-acre AI Innovation City.
• Option C is Incorrect: Hyderabad hosts major tech clusters, but this specific $11B project is sited near Navi Mumbai.
• Option D is Incorrect: GIFT City is a dedicated International Financial Services Centre in Gujarat.

national_questions.qe: Which launch vehicle was used by ISRO to deploy EOS-05, India's first dedicated imaging satellite in geosynchronous orbit?
national_questions.qh: भू-समकालिक कक्षा में भारत के पहले समर्पित इमेजिंग उपग्रह 'EOS-05' को प्रक्षेपित करने के लिए ISRO द्वारा किस प्रक्षेपण यान का उपयोग किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: ISRO successfully deployed EOS-05, India's first dedicated imaging satellite in geosynchronous orbit, aboard the GSLV-F17 launch vehicle (its 19th flight) from Sriharikota.
• Option A is Incorrect: PSLV-C58 was used to launch XPoSat.
• Option C is Incorrect: LVM3-M4 was used for the Chandrayaan-3 lunar mission.
• Option D is Incorrect: SSLV-D3 was used for launching the EOS-08 small satellite mission.

national_questions.qe: Which satellite was launched by ISRO aboard the GSLV-F17 mission as India's first Earth-observation imaging satellite designed for a geosynchronous orbit?
national_questions.qh: जीएसएलवी-एफ17 (GSLV-F17) मिशन के माध्यम से इसरो द्वारा प्रक्षेपित भारत का पहला भू-समकालिक कक्षा (Geosynchronous Orbit) हेतु डिज़ाइन किया गया पृथ्वी अवलोकन इमेजिंग उपग्रह कौन-सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because EOS-05 is India’s first Earth-observation imaging satellite designed for a geosynchronous orbit, launched aboard the GSLV-F17 rocket from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota.
• Option A is Incorrect because EOS-03 was an earlier Earth Observation Satellite launched in 2021.
• Option C is Incorrect because EOS-06 (Oceansat-3) was launched in 2022 primarily for oceanographic data.
• Option D is Incorrect because EOS-07 was a technology demonstration satellite launched aboard SSLV-D2 in 2023.

national_questions.qe: Which state's Lok Bhavan became the first in India to receive the Indian Green Building Council (IGBC) Platinum certification under the Green Campus v1 rating system?
national_questions.qh: ग्रीन कैम्पस v1 रेटिंग प्रणाली के तहत इंडियन ग्रीन बिल्डिंग काउंसिल (IGBC) का प्लैटिनम प्रमाणन प्राप्त करने वाला भारत का पहला लोक भवन किस राज्य में स्थित है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Odisha's Lok Bhavan in Bhubaneswar became the first Lok Bhavan in India to achieve the prestigious IGBC Platinum certification under the Green Campus v1 rating system with a score of 88/100.
• Option A is Incorrect because Gujarat has other green certified structures, but not the first Platinum certified Lok Bhavan.
• Option B is Incorrect because Madhya Pradesh's state headquarters did not receive this specific rating.
• Option D is Incorrect because Maharashtra's administrative building was not the first campus to achieve this certification.

national_questions.qe: Which portal is used for Aadhaar‑seeded bank account linking and DBT disbursement under the Post‑Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste students?
national_questions.qh: शेड्यूल्ड पोस्ट‑मैट्रिक स्कॉलरशिप योजना के तहत अनुसूचित जाति छात्रों के लिए आधार‑सीडेड बैंक खाते की लिंकिंग और डीबीटी भुगतान के लिए कौन सा पोर्टल उपयोग किया जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) is the nodal platform for the Post‑Matric Scholarship Scheme, where Aadhaar‑seeded bank accounts are linked and DBT disbursements are processed.
• Option B is Incorrect as the PM Kisan Portal deals with farmer income support, not scholarship disbursement.
• Option C is Incorrect because e‑Nagarsewa is a municipal service portal.
• Option D is Incorrect; MyGov is a citizen engagement platform, not used for scholarship DBT.

national_questions.qe: In which city did the Prime Minister inaugurate three sections of the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor covering 326 route km?
national_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री ने पश्चिमी समर्पित माल पथ के 326 किमी के तीन खंडों का उद्घाटन किस शहर में किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the inauguration ceremony was held in Vadodara, where three key sections of the WDFC were dedicated.
• Option A is Incorrect; Ahmedabad was not the venue of this event.
• Option C is Incorrect; Surat was not mentioned in the inauguration.
• Option D is Incorrect; Rajkot was not the location of the ceremony.

national_questions.qe: The Defence Acquisition Council approved Acceptance of Necessity for procurement proposals worth approximately how much?
national_questions.qh: डिफेन्स एक्विज़िशन काउंसिल ने लगभग कितनी राशि के लिए एक्विज़िशन प्रस्तावों को स्वीकृति (AoN) दी?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the DAC gave AoN to capital acquisition proposals totaling about ₹1.10 lakh crore.
• Option A is Incorrect; the amount is far lower than the approved figure.
• Option B is Incorrect; the approved amount exceeds ₹78,000 crore.
• Option D is Incorrect; the approved total does not reach ₹1,45,000 crore.

national_questions.qe: Luxembourg reaffirmed its support for the swift conclusion and ratification of which trade agreement involving India?
national_questions.qh: लग्ज़मबर्ग ने भारत के साथ किस व्यापार समझौते के शीघ्र निष्कर्ष और अनुमोदन के लिए अपना समर्थन दोहराया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Luxembourg specifically supported the swift conclusion and ratification of the India‑European Union Free Trade Agreement (EU‑FTA).
• Option A is Incorrect; the India‑UK FTA was not mentioned.
• Option B is Incorrect; the India‑ASEAN FTA was not part of the discussion.
• Option C is Incorrect; the India‑RCEP was not referenced in the meeting.

national_questions.qe: What is the primary objective of the recent space sector reforms clarified by ISRO?
national_questions.qh: ISRO द्वारा स्पष्ट किए गए हालिया अंतरिक्ष क्षेत्र सुधारों का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
oe: To build a larger, globally competitive ecosystem
To transfer all operational tasks to private firms
oh: ISRO को पूरी तरह से निजी बनाना
एक बड़ा, वैश्विक प्रतिस्पर्धी इकोसिस्टम बनाना
ISRO के अनुसंधान कार्यों को घटाना
सभी परिचालन कार्य निजी कंपनियों को सौंपना
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because ISRO clarified that the reforms aim to expand India’s space ecosystem and enhance global competitiveness, not to privatise the agency.
• Option A is Incorrect because the reforms explicitly state that privatisation is not the goal.
• Option C is Incorrect as ISRO will continue high‑end research and next‑generation missions.
• Option D is Incorrect; operational tasks will be shared, not fully transferred.

national_questions.qe: What is the length of the newly inaugurated Priority Corridor‑2 of the Indore Metro?
national_questions.qh: इंदौर मेट्रो के नव inaugurated प्रायोरिटी कॉरिडोर‑2 की लंबाई कितनी है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Priority Corridor‑2 (Reach‑II) that was inaugurated spans 11 kilometres.
• Option B is Incorrect; 14 km is not mentioned in the inauguration details.
• Option C is Incorrect; 17 km refers to the total network length after the expansion, not the new corridor alone.
• Option D is Incorrect; 20 km is not related to this project.

national_questions.qe: Which resolution did the UN General Assembly adopt to address the distortion of Africa’s size on conventional maps?
national_questions.qh: अफ़्रीका के आकार के मानचित्रीय विकृति को दूर करने के लिए संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा ने कौन सा प्रस्ताव अपनाया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the UNGA adopted the non‑binding ‘Correct the Map’ resolution to encourage use of accurate map projections for Africa.
• Option A is Incorrect; while the Equal Earth projection is recommended, it is not the name of the resolution.
• Option B is Incorrect; no such ‘Mercator Reform’ resolution was passed.
• Option C is Incorrect; the resolution’s official title is not ‘Geographical Accuracy’.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian‑backed infrastructure project’s first segment was recently completed in the Maldives?
national_questions.qh: मालदीव में हाल ही में पूरा किया गया भारतीय‑समर्थित बुनियादी ढाँचा परियोजना का पहला खंड कौन‑सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Ministry of External Affairs announced the completion of the first segment of the Greater Malé Connectivity Project in the Maldives.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Lakshadweep Sea Link is a domestic Indian project.
• Option B is Incorrect; the Andaman Trunk Road is unrelated to Maldives.
• Option D is Incorrect; the Sunderbans Flood Barrier pertains to India’s eastern coastal region.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry organized the National Departmental Summit on Water where Prime Minister Narendra Modi delivered the valedictory address?
national_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने वैलिडेटरी सत्र दिया, वह राष्ट्रीय जल विभागीय शिखर सम्मेलन किस मंत्रालय ने आयोजित किया?
oe: Ministry of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
oh: जल संसाधन, नदी विकास एवं गंगा पुनरुद्धार मंत्रालय
पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the summit was convened by the Ministry of Jal Shakti, the nodal agency for water resources and management.
• Option B is Incorrect because that ministry deals with river‑specific projects, not the overarching water‑sector summit.
• Option C is Incorrect as it focuses on environmental policy, not the dedicated water‑departmental summit.
• Option D is Incorrect; rural development deals with livelihoods, not the national water policy forum.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian private company became the first to achieve orbital launch capability?
national_questions.qh: कौन सी भारतीय निजी कंपनी ने पहली बार कक्षा में प्रक्षेपण क्षमता हासिल की?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Skyroot Aerospace successfully launched its Vikram‑S rocket into orbit, marking the first orbital capability for an Indian private firm.
• Option A is Incorrect; Agnikul Cosmos is developing sub‑orbital launchers and has not yet achieved orbital flight.
• Option C is Incorrect; Team Indus was a lunar‑mission contender and did not attain orbital launch.
• Option D is Incorrect; Bellatrix Aerospace focuses on propulsion technologies and has not completed an orbital launch.

national_questions.qe: Which public sector entity commissioned India's first geothermal wells in the Puga Valley, Ladakh?
national_questions.qh: पुगा वैली, लद्दाख में भारत के पहले भू‑तापीय कुओं का कमिशनिंग किस सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र की इकाई ने किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the ONGC Energy Centre executed the drilling of two ~1,000 m deep geothermal wells in Puga Valley, enabling the 1 MW pilot project.
• Option A is Incorrect; Indian Oil Corporation is not involved in geothermal drilling.
• Option B is Incorrect; NTPC focuses on thermal and hydro power, not geothermal wells.
• Option D is Incorrect; Power Grid handles transmission, not resource exploration.

national_questions.qe: Which hospital installed India's first upright proton therapy system?
national_questions.qh: भारत में पहला उभरा हुआ प्रोटॉन थेरेपी सिस्टम किस अस्पताल ने स्थापित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Fortis Memorial Research Institute in Gurugram installed the MEVION S250‑FIT™ upright proton therapy system, the first of its kind in India.
• Option A is Incorrect; AIIMS Delhi does not yet have an upright proton therapy unit.
• Option B is Incorrect; Apollo Hospitals currently operate conventional radiotherapy, not upright proton therapy.
• Option C is Incorrect; Max Healthcare also lacks this specific technology.

national_questions.qe: Which satellite, launched by ISRO on GSLV‑F17 on 4 September 2026, is India’s first imaging satellite placed in a geosynchronous orbit?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा उपग्रह, जिसे 4 सितंबर 2026 को ISRO ने GSLV‑F17 से लॉन्च किया, भारत का पहला भू‑स्थिर कक्षा में स्थापित इमेजिंग उपग्रह है?
national_questions.e: • Option B is Correct because EOS‑05 was launched on 4 Sep 2026 by ISRO on GSLV‑F17 and is the first Indian imaging satellite designed for a geosynchronous orbit (85.5° E). It weighs 2,367 kg, the heaviest payload ever launched by a GSLV, and will provide continuous high‑frequency Earth imaging. • Option A is Incorrect because RISAT‑2B is a radar‑imaging satellite in low‑Earth orbit, not geosynchronous. • Option C is Incorrect because Cartosat‑3 is a high‑resolution optical satellite in LEO, not the first geosynchronous imaging satellite. • Option D is Incorrect because GSAT‑30 is a communication satellite, not an imaging payload.

national_questions.qe: The first hydrogen‑powered train in India, trialled on the Jind‑Sonipat route, is operated by which organization?
national_questions.qh: जिंद‑सोनिपत मार्ग पर परीक्षण किए गए भारत के पहले हाइड्रोजन‑पावर वाले ट्रेन को कौन संचालित करता है?
national_questions.e: • Option A is Correct because the hydrogen‑powered train is a project of Indian Railways, which conducted the 120 kmph trial on the 89‑km Jind‑Sonipat line in Haryana. • Option B is Incorrect as Delhi Metro operates metro services in the National Capital Region, not hydrogen‑train trials. • Option C is Incorrect because ISRO deals with space missions, not railway propulsion. • Option D is Incorrect as the National High Speed Rail Corporation focuses on bullet‑train corridors, not hydrogen technology.

national_questions.qe: Which statement is true regarding Pixxel’s first private commercial imaging satellite?
national_questions.qh: पिक्सेल के पहले निजी वाणिज्यिक इमेजिंग उपग्रह के बारे में कौन सा कथन सही है?
oe: It was launched on a GSLV Mk III
It belongs to the Cartosat series
It operates in a geosynchronous orbit
oh: यह GSLV Mk III से लॉन्च हुआ
यह Cartosat श्रृंखला का हिस्सा है
यह SpaceX के माध्यम से लॉन्च हुआ
यह भू‑स्थिर कक्षा में कार्य करता है
national_questions.e: • Option C is Correct because Pixxel’s Honeybee constellation’s first private commercial imaging satellite was launched using SpaceX’s launch services, marking India’s inaugural private sector imaging payload. • Option A is Incorrect as the launch was not on an ISRO GSLV Mk III. • Option B is Incorrect because the satellite is not part of the Cartosat series, which are ISRO‑operated. • Option D is Incorrect because the satellite operates in low‑Earth orbit, not geosynchronous.

national_questions.qe: Which launch vehicle was used to place EOS‑05 into orbit?
national_questions.qh: EOS‑05 को कक्षा में स्थापित करने के लिए कौन सा प्रक्षेपण यान उपयोग किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because EOS‑05 was launched aboard ISRO’s GSLV‑F17 (19th GSLV mission) from Sriharikota.
• Option B is Incorrect because PSLV‑C55 was not associated with this mission.
• Option C is Incorrect because GSLV Mk III (LVM3) is a different heavy‑lift vehicle.
• Option D is Incorrect because LVM3 is another name for GSLV Mk III, not the launch vehicle used.

national_questions.qe: EOS‑05 is India's first imaging satellite placed in which type of orbit?
national_questions.qh: EOS‑05 भारत का पहला इमेजिंग उपग्रह किस प्रकार की कक्षा में स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because EOS‑05 is the first Indian imaging satellite positioned in a geosynchronous orbit (~36,000 km).
• Option A is Incorrect as LEO satellites orbit much lower (≈200‑2,000 km).
• Option C is Incorrect because MEO is used mainly for navigation constellations.
• Option D is Incorrect; Sun‑synchronous orbits are polar, not geosynchronous.

national_questions.qe: What was the launch mass of the EOS‑05 satellite?
national_questions.qh: EOS‑05 उपग्रह का प्रक्षेपण भार कितना था?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because official data state EOS‑05 weighed 2,367 kg, the heaviest payload ever carried by a GSLV.
• Option A is Incorrect; 1,500 kg is far below the actual mass.
• Option B is Incorrect; 2,000 kg does not match the reported figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; 3,000 kg exceeds the stated launch mass.

national_questions.qe: The primary purpose of EOS‑05 is to provide which type of service?
national_questions.qh: EOS‑05 का मुख्य उद्देश्य किस प्रकार की सेवा प्रदान करना है?
oe: Earth‑observation imaging for weather forecasting and agriculture
oh: मौसम पूर्वानुमान और कृषि के लिए पृथ्वी‑पर्यवेक्षण इमेजिंग
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because EOS‑05 is designed to deliver high‑resolution, large‑area Earth‑observation imagery to aid weather forecasting, agriculture and disaster management.
• Option A is Incorrect; communication payloads are not part of EOS‑05’s mission.
• Option B is Incorrect; navigation services are provided by satellites like NavIC.
• Option C is Incorrect; EOS‑05 is an Earth‑observation satellite, not a deep‑space probe.

national_questions.qe: Which ministry chaired the National Steering Committee that approved the ₹735.70 crore investment for ITI clusters under PM‑SETU?
national_questions.qh: पीएम‑सेटु के तहत आईटीआई क्लस्टर के लिए 735.70 करोड़ रुपये के निवेश को मंजूरी देने वाले राष्ट्रीय स्टियरींग कमेटी की अध्यक्षता किस मंत्रालय ने की?
oe: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the committee was chaired by MSDE Secretary Debashree Mukherjee.
• Option B is Incorrect; the Ministry of Education was not involved.

national_questions.qe: According to the amended Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, how is the 'prior price' strictly defined for validating genuine discounted prices on e-commerce platforms?

The lowest price at which the product was offered during the preceding 30 days
The Maximum Retail Price (MRP) established by the manufacturer
The median price at which the product was sold over the past calendar quarter

पिछले 30 दिनों के दौरान वह न्यूनतम कीमत जिस पर उत्पाद बेचा गया था
निर्माता द्वारा निर्धारित अधिकतम खुदरा मूल्य (MRP)
पिछली तिमाही में जिस मध्यस्थ मूल्य पर उत्पाद बेचा गया था
national_questions.e:

• Option A is Incorrect because the regulatory timeframe is specified as 30 days rather than 60 days, requiring the lowest price rather than an average.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Maximum Retail Price (MRP) does not constitute the benchmark for discounted pricing disclosures.
• Option D is Incorrect because median prices over a quarterly timeline are not used in these rules.

national_questions.qe: Under which schedule of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 is the Indian Star Tortoise (Geochelone elegans) classified to accord it the highest statutory protection against illegal trade?
national_questions.qh: अवैध व्यापार से उच्चतम वैधानिक संरक्षण प्रदान करने के लिए भारतीय स्टार कछुआ (जियोचेलोन एलिगेंस) को वन्यजीव (संरक्षण) अधिनियम, 1972 की किस अनुसूची के तहत वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Indian Star Tortoise (Geochelone elegans) is protected under Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972, granting it top-tier legal protection and strict penalties for poaching.
• Option A is Incorrect because Schedule III lists species provided lesser degrees of statutory protection.
• Option B is Incorrect because Schedule II does not accord the absolute highest legal protection status reserved for Schedule I fauna.
• Option D is Incorrect because Schedule IV specifies protected plant species post-amendment.

national_questions.qe: Which district recently became the first in Mizoram to attain 'Surakshit' status under the National AIDS Control Organisation's (NACO) Mobilisation AIDS Suraksha campaign?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में राष्ट्रीय एड्स नियंत्रण संगठन (NACO) के 'मोबिलाइजेशन एड्स सुरक्षा' (MAS) अभियान के तहत 'सुरक्षित' दर्जा हासिल करने वाला मिजोरम का पहला जिला कौन सा बना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because Saitual district in Mizoram became the first district in the state to attain 'Surakshit' status under NACO's Mobilisation AIDS Suraksha (MAS) campaign by fulfilling all UNAIDS 95-95-95 targets.
• Option A is Incorrect because Aizawl is the capital of Mizoram but not the first district to achieve this specific status.
• Option C is Incorrect because Lunglei is another major district of Mizoram which has not achieved this recognition yet.
• Option D is Incorrect because Champhai is a border district in Mizoram and has not been designated as the first 'Surakshit' district.

national_questions.qe: What is the official theme of the 9th Rashtriya Poshan Maah observed across India?
national_questions.qh: भारत भर में मनाए जा रहे 9वें राष्ट्रीय पोषण माह का आधिकारिक विषय (थीम) क्या है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the 9th Rashtriya Poshan Maah is observed across the country under the central theme 'Hamari Anganwadi, Hamari Jimmedari' (Our Anganwadi, Our Responsibility).
• Option A is Incorrect because 'Poshan Bhi, Padhai Bhi' is an ECCE flagship initiative under the Ministry of Women and Child Development, not the main theme for this edition.
• Option B is Incorrect because 'Sahi Poshan, Desh Roshan' was an earlier tagline of the Poshan Abhiyaan.
• Option D is Incorrect because 'Kuposhan Mukt Bharat 2030' refers to a general policy vision rather than the specific theme of the 9th Rashtriya Poshan Maah.

national_questions.qe: On which date is International Literacy Day celebrated globally every year following its proclamation by UNESCO in 1966?
national_questions.qh: वर्ष 1966 में यूनेस्को द्वारा घोषित किए जाने के बाद प्रतिवर्ष दुनिया भर में 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय साक्षरता दिवस' किस तिथि को मनाया जाता है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because International Literacy Day is observed worldwide on 8th September every year to highlight literacy as a matter of dignity and human rights.
• Option B is Incorrect because 15th September is celebrated as National Engineers' Day and International Day of Democracy.
• Option C is Incorrect because 5th October is celebrated as World Teachers' Day.
• Option D is Incorrect because 24th January is observed as National Girl Child Day and International Day of Education.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian city hosted Stage 3 of the World Archery Para Series where world champion Sheetal Devi reached the women's compound individual final?
national_questions.qh: किस भारतीय शहर ने 'विश्व तीरंदाजी पैरा सीरीज चरण 3' की मेजबानी की, जहाँ विश्व चैंपियन शीतल देवी ने महिला कंपाउंड व्यक्तिगत फाइनल में प्रवेश किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because Stage 3 of the World Archery Para Series was hosted in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, where world champion Sheetal Devi advanced to the women's compound final.
• Option A is Incorrect because New Delhi did not host Stage 3 of this World Archery Para event.
• Option B is Incorrect because Bengaluru was not selected as the host city for this tournament stage.
• Option C is Incorrect because Hyderabad hosted the NITI Aayog Ayush Workshop, not the World Archery Para Series.

national_questions.qe: Which forum or association recently launched the 'CSS Shield' initiative to provide structured mutual financial assistance to the families of deceased officers?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में दिवंगत अधिकारियों के परिवारों को संरचित पारस्परिक वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करने के लिए किस मंच या संघ ने 'CSS शील्ड' पहल शुरू की है?
oe: Central Armed Police Forces Benevolent Fund
Indian Audit and Accounts Service Association
oh: केंद्रीय सशस्त्र पुलिस बल परोपकारी कोष
भारतीय लेखापरीक्षण एवं लेखा सेवा संघ
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the 'CSS Shield' initiative was launched by the Central Secretariat Service (CSS) Forum to establish a structured mutual financial support mechanism for the families of deceased officers, aiming to provide at least Rs 15 lakh in financial assistance.
• Option B is Incorrect because the initiative is specific to the Central Secretariat Service officers, not the IAS Association.

national_questions.qe: In which State or Union Territory was the inaugural two-day Drass District Festival organized to promote eco-tourism and Himalayan Brown Bear conservation?
national_questions.qh: पर्यावरण-पर्यटन और हिमालयी भूरे भालू के संरक्षण को बढ़ावा देने के लिए किस राज्य या केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में पहले दो दिवसीय द्रास जिला महोत्सव का आयोजन किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the inaugural Drass District Festival was organized in the Drass and Mushkoh valleys of Ladakh to boost eco-tourism and raise conservation awareness for the endangered Himalayan Brown Bear.
• Option A is Incorrect because Drass is administratively part of the Union Territory of Ladakh, not Jammu and Kashmir.
• Option C is Incorrect because Himachal Pradesh was not the venue for this festival.
• Option D is Incorrect because Uttarakhand is not associated with this event.

national_questions.qe: India's first museum dedicated to linguistic diversity, named 'Shabdalok', has been established at which of the following historical locations?
national_questions.qh: भाषाई विविधता को समर्पित भारत का पहला संग्रहालय, जिसका नाम 'शब्दलोक' है, निम्नलिखित में से किस ऐतिहासिक स्थान पर स्थापित किया गया है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because 'Shabdalok', India's first museum dedicated to linguistic diversity, is established at Belvedere House on the National Library campus in Kolkata, West Bengal.
• Option A is Incorrect because it is not situated at the National Museum in New Delhi.
• Option B is Incorrect because it is not located at the Asiatic Society in Mumbai.
• Option D is Incorrect because it is not housed in the Salar Jung Museum in Hyderabad.

national_questions.qe: Which medical condition is the primary focus of India's first nationwide genome-wide association study (GWAS) involving 2,523 women across 18 research centers?
national_questions.qh: 18 अनुसंधान केंद्रों में 2,523 महिलाओं को शामिल करने वाले भारत के पहले राष्ट्रव्यापी जीनोम-वाइड एसोसिएशन अध्ययन (GWAS) का प्राथमिक ध्यान किस चिकित्सा स्थिति पर है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the landmark study is India’s first nationwide genome-wide study focused on endometriosis, identifying 21 genetic loci including WNT4 and CDKN2B-AS1 to enable precision medicine.
• Option B is Incorrect because Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) was not the subject of this specific genome study.
• Option C is Incorrect because cervical cancer research is distinct from this GWAS initiative on reproductive health.
• Option D is Incorrect because sickle cell anemia is a genetic blood disorder targeted under separate national elimination missions.

national_questions.qe: In which year is the first operational section (Surat-Vapi) of India's Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail Corridor scheduled to open?
national_questions.qh: भारत के मुंबई-अहमदाबाद हाई-स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर का पहला परिचालन खंड (सूरत-वापी) किस वर्ष खोलने की योजना है?
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Ministry of Railways announced that the 100-km Surat-Vapi section of India's first indigenously manufactured bullet train project will be inaugurated in 2027 following trial runs.
• Option A is Incorrect because track trials for the bullet train are scheduled for mid-2027, making 2025 inaccurate.
• Option C is Incorrect because 2029 is beyond the targeted inauguration year for the initial Surat-Vapi stretch.
• Option D is Incorrect because 2030 relates to broader long-term railway expansion targets.

national_questions.qe: In which forest division of Uttarakhand has India's first AI-powered forest acoustic surveillance system been deployed to curb wildlife crimes and poaching?
national_questions.qh: वन्यजीव अपराधों और अवैध शिकार को रोकने के लिए भारत की पहली AI-संचालित वन ध्वनिक निगरानी प्रणाली उत्तराखंड के किस वन प्रभाग में तैनात की गई है?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because India's first AI-based forest acoustic surveillance system was deployed in the Haldwani forest division, utilizing solar-powered LoRa acoustic sensors to track illegal logging and poaching.
• Option A is Incorrect because Corbett Forest Division is a renowned tiger reserve but not the site for this initial AI acoustic system.
• Option B is Incorrect because Rajaji Forest Division was not selected for this specific pilot implementation.
• Option D is Incorrect because Dehradun Forest Division is not associated with this new acoustic surveillance deployment.

national_questions.qe: Which rocket was launched by ISRO to place EOS-05, India's first dedicated Earth observation satellite, into a geosynchronous transfer orbit?
national_questions.qh: भू-समकालिक कक्षा में भारत के पहले समर्पित पृथ्वी अवलोकन उपग्रह EOS-05 को स्थापित करने के लिए इसरो द्वारा किस रॉकेट को प्रक्षेपित किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because ISRO successfully launched EOS-05 (weighing 2,367 kg) using GSLV-F17, which carried the heaviest payload ever launched by a GSLV rocket into a sub-geosynchronous transfer orbit.
• Option A is Incorrect because PSLV-C58 was used for the XPoSAT scientific mission.
• Option B is Incorrect because LVM3-M4 was the launch vehicle used for Chandrayaan-3.
• Option C is Incorrect because SSLV-D3 is designed for launching micro and mini satellites into low Earth orbit.

national_questions.qe: In which year was the Indian Forest Act amended to exclude bamboo grown in non‑forest areas from the definition of a “tree”?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय वन अधिनियम में बांस को ‘वृक्ष’ की परिभाषा से बाहर करने के लिए संशोधन किस वर्ष किया गया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the 2017 amendment to the Indian Forest Act, 1927 removed bamboo cultivated in non‑forest areas from the definition of a tree, thereby deregulating its harvest.
• Option B is Incorrect; no amendment was made in 2015.
• Option C is Incorrect; the amendment did not occur in 2019.
• Option D is Incorrect; 2021 saw no such change.

national_questions.qe: The Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue (VBYLD) is scheduled to be held in which year?
national_questions.qh: विकसित भारत युवा नेताओं संवाद (VBYLD) किस वर्ष आयोजित किया जाएगा?
national_questions.e:

• Option C is Incorrect; 2030 is unrelated.

national_questions.qe: Which committee of the RBI is tracking West Asia crude‑oil price dynamics to assess their impact on domestic inflation?
national_questions.qh: आरबीआई की कौन सी समिति पश्चिम एशिया के कच्चे तेल की कीमतों को ट्रैक कर रही है ताकि उनका घरेलू महंगाई पर प्रभाव आकलन किया जा सके?
national_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the RBI’s Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) monitors global oil price movements, including West Asia crude, to gauge inflationary pressures.
• Option A is Incorrect; the Financial Stability Committee focuses on systemic risks, not oil price tracking.
• Option B is Incorrect; the Board of Governors provides overall governance, not day‑to‑day price monitoring.

national_questions.qe: Under SEBI’s proposed new methodology, which component is included from the Closing Auction Session for calculating expiry‑day derivative settlement prices?

oe: Trades from the first 30 minutes of the Continuous Trading Session
Trades from the final 30 minutes of the Continuous Trading Session
Trades from the final 10 minutes of the Closing Auction Session

निरंतर ट्रेडिंग सत्र के अंतिम 30 मिनट के ट्रेड
क्लोज़िंग ऑक्शन सत्र के अंतिम 10 मिनट के ट्रेड

• Option A is Incorrect; the first 30 minutes are not part of the proposed blend.
• Option B is Incorrect; while the final 30 minutes of CTS are included, the specific new element is the last 10 minutes of CAS.
• Option C is Incorrect; opening auction trades are excluded from the new methodology.

national_questions.qe: Which Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) country is NOT part of the Comprehensive Free Trade Agreement negotiations launched by India during its 2026 BRICS Presidency?
national_questions.qh: भारत द्वारा 2026 में ब्रिक्स अध्यक्षता के दौरान शुरू किए गए व्यापक मुक्त व्यापार समझौते (CFTA) में शामिल नहीं किया गया GCC देश कौन सा है?

national_questions.qe: What is the theme of the 'Swachhata Hi Seva 2026' campaign launched by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs?
national_questions.qh: हाउसिंग और शहरी मामलों के मंत्रालय द्वारा लॉन्च किए गए 'स्वच्छता ही सेवा 2026' अभियान का थीम क्या है?
oe: Swachhata Mein Sahbhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat
oh: स्वच्छता में सहभाग, स्वच्छ भारत, विकसित भारत
national_questions.e: • Option A (Swachhata Mein Sahbhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat) is Correct as the official campaign theme mentioned in the briefing. • Option B is Incorrect; it omits the word ‘Viksit’. • Option C is Incorrect; it is not the official slogan. • Option D is Incorrect; it reverses the order and misses ‘Viksit’.

national_questions.qe: According to Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal at the BRICS Women’s Business Alliance forum, what percentage of small business loans extended in India have been granted to women entrepreneurs?

national_questions.e: • Option C (68%) is Correct because the minister stated that over 68% of the 560 million small‑business loans have gone to women entrepreneurs. • Option A (45%) is Incorrect; the figure is much lower than the reported value. • Option B (55%) is Incorrect; it does not match the cited statistic. • Option D (75%) is Incorrect; the actual share is slightly lower than 75%.

national_questions.qe: During Defence Minister Rajnath Singh's visit to Sri Lanka, which percentage of India's contribution to global GDP growth in Q1 FY 2026-27 was highlighted?
national_questions.qh: श्री राजनाथ सिंह की श्रीलंका यात्रा के दौरान भारत की Q1 FY 2026-27 में वैश्विक जीडीपी वृद्धि में योगदान के रूप में किस प्रतिशत वृद्धि को उजागर किया गया?

national_questions.qe: Which scheme for FY 2025-26 was kept in abeyance after concerns raised by public sector bank employees?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा योजना FY 2025-26 के लिए सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के बैंक कर्मचारियों की चिंताओं के बाद स्थगित कर दी गई?

oh: बैंकों के लिए परफॉर्मेंस लिंक्ड इंसेंटिव (PLI) योजना
national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Performance Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme dated 19‑11‑2024 for FY 2025‑26 was kept in abeyance following the delegation of PSB employees.

national_questions.qe: Which Indian minister made the first dedicated bilateral visit to Ukraine as External Affairs Minister?
national_questions.qh: कौन से भारतीय मंत्री ने यूक्रेन के साथ पहली समर्पित द्विपक्षीय यात्रा के दौरान विदेश मंत्री के रूप में यात्रा की?

national_questions.qh: ईएएम जयशंकर की कीव यात्रा के दौरान भारत ने यूक्रेन को कितनी मानवीय सहायता की कंसाइनमेंट भेजी है?

national_questions.qe: Which cryogenic engine underwent its first flight‑acceptance hot test at 220 kN thrust at ISRO Propulsion Complex, Mahendragiri, enhancing LVM3’s payload capability?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा क्रायोजेनिक इंजन महेंद्रागिरी स्थित इसरो प्रोपल्शन कॉम्प्लेक्स में 220 kN थ्रस्ट के साथ पहला फ़्लाइट‑एक्सेप्टेंस हॉट टेस्ट कर चुका, जिससे LVM3 की पेलोड क्षमता बढ़ी?

national_questions.qe: Which Indian steel plant commissioned the country's first coke‑oven‑gas injection technology in a blast furnace to cut CO₂ emissions?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा भारतीय इस्पात प्लांट ब्लास्ट फर्नेस में देश की पहली कोक‑ओवन‑गैस इंजेक्शन तकनीक लागू करके CO₂ उत्सर्जन कम करने के लिए स्थापित किया?
national_questions.e:

national_questions.qe: What is the name of India's first dedicated imaging satellite placed in geosynchronous orbit launched by GSLV‑F17 on 4 September 2026?
national_questions.qh: 4 सितंबर 2026 को GSLV‑F17 द्वारा लॉन्च किया गया भारत का पहला समकालिक कक्षा (जियो‑सिंक्रोनस) इमेजिंग उपग्रह कौन सा है?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because EOS‑05 is the first Indian imaging satellite designed for geosynchronous orbit, launched by ISRO on GSLV‑F17, weighing 2,367 kg – the heaviest payload ever on a GSLV.

national_questions.qe: Which new international framework was proposed by India during the BRICS session on 'Inclusive Global Governance and Strengthening Multilateralism' to assist maritime workers?
national_questions.qh: समुद्री श्रमिकों की सहायता के लिए 'समावेशी वैश्विक शासन और बहुपक्षवाद को मजबूत करना' पर ब्रिक्स सत्र के दौरान भारत द्वारा किस नई अंतरराष्ट्रीय पहल का प्रस्ताव रखा गया था?
national_questions.e:
