national_questions.qe: The 51.38 km long Bairabi-Sairang railway line project, featuring a pier bridge rising 114 meters, connects the national railway grid to which North-Eastern state capital threshold?
national_questions.qh: 114 मीटर ऊंचे पियर ब्रिज वाली 51.38 किमी लंबी बैराबी-सैरांग रेलवे लाइन परियोजना भारतीय रेलवे नेटवर्क को किस पूर्वोत्तर राज्य से जोड़ती है?
national_questions.e:

national_questions.qe: Which new mechanism was proposed by India at the BRICS Summit 2026 to maintain institutional momentum and ensure continuity through the Troika structure?

national_questions.e:

national_questions.qe: Which highest military bravery award available to Indian soldiers at the time was posthumously conferred upon the 21 Sikh soldiers for their defense in the Battle of Saragarhi (1897)?
national_questions.qh: 1897 के सारागढ़ी के युद्ध में अदम्य साहस दिखाने वाले 21 सिख सैनिकों को मरणोपरांत तत्कालीन भारतीय सैनिकों के लिए उपलब्ध किस सर्वोच्च सैन्य वीरता पुरस्कार से सम्मानित किया गया था?

national_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because all 21 Sikh soldiers of the 36th Sikh Regiment involved in the Battle of Saragarhi were posthumously awarded the Indian Order of Merit (IOM), which was the highest bravery award available to Indian soldiers under British rule at that time.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Victoria Cross was not made available to native Indian soldiers prior to 1911.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Distinguished Service Order was typically awarded to senior officers for leadership, not frontline combat bravery.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Param Vir Chakra was instituted post-independence in 1950.

national_questions.qe: Which school secured the top national position and received the Pt. Jawahar Lal Nehru Running Parliamentary Shield in the 27th National Youth Parliament Competition?
national_questions.qh: 27वीं राष्ट्रीय युवा संसद प्रतियोगिता में किस विद्यालय ने प्रथम राष्ट्रीय स्थान प्राप्त कर पंडित जवाहरलाल नेहरू रनिंग संसदीय शील्ड हासिल की?

national_questions.qe: At which venue was the National Workshop on 'Strengthening the Ayush Ecosystem' organized by NITI Aayog held?
national_questions.qh: नीति आयोग द्वारा आयोजित 'आयुष पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र को मजबूत करना' विषय पर राष्ट्रीय कार्यशाला किस स्थान पर आयोजित की गई थी?

national_questions.qe: Where was the 9th National Nutrition Month officially inaugurated?
national_questions.qh: 9वें राष्ट्रीय पोषण माह का औपचारिक उद्घाटन निम्नलिखित में से किस स्थान पर किया गया?

national_questions.qe: Which company launched India's first in-car fuel payment solution on TATA.CARS using NPCI's UPI Circle and IndianOil?
national_questions.qh: एनपीसीआई के यूपीआई सर्किल और इंडियनऑयल के माध्यम से टाटा कार्स पर भारत का पहला इन-कार ईंधन भुगतान समाधान किस कंपनी ने लॉन्च किया है?

national_questions.qe: India's first fully automated AI-powered 'lights-out' factory lab was launched by Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) in which city?
national_questions.qh: टाटा कंसल्टेंसी सर्विसेज (TCS) द्वारा भारत की पहली पूरी तरह से स्वचालित एआई-संचालित 'लाइट्स-आउट' फैक्टरी लैब किस शहर में शुरू की गई है?

national_questions.qe: Where did the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully conduct the flight-acceptance hot test of the uprated 220 kN CE20 cryogenic engine?
national_questions.qh: भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन (ISRO) ने उन्नत 220 kN क्षमता वाले CE20 क्रायोजेनिक इंजन का सफल हॉट परीक्षण कहाँ आयोजित किया?
national_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the 165-second flight-acceptance hot test of the uprated CE20 cryogenic engine at 220 kN thrust was successfully conducted at the ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC) in Mahendragiri, Tamil Nadu.
• Option B is Incorrect because Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC) in Kerala specializes in rocket and launch vehicle development.
• Option C is Incorrect because Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC) in Sriharikota is India's primary rocket launching site.

national_questions.qe: Which satellite was recently launched by ISRO using the GSLV-F17 rocket as India's first dedicated Earth observation satellite in geosynchronous orbit?
national_questions.qh: हाल ही में ISRO द्वारा GSLV-F17 रॉकेट के माध्यम से भू-तुल्यकालिक कक्षा (Geosynchronous Orbit) में भारत के पहले समर्पित भू-प्रेक्षण उपग्रह के रूप में किसे लॉन्च किया गया?

• Option D is Incorrect because EOS-06 (Oceansat-3) was launched into a Sun-synchronous orbit aboard PSLV-C54 in 2022.

national_questions.qe: Which enforcement agency launched 'Operation Deep Manifest' to bust an illicit import syndicate routing prohibited goods into India?

national_questions.qe: Which country did the Indian Women's cricket team defeat in the final to secure a record-extending eighth Women's Asia Cup title?

national_questions.qe: In which city was the 6th All India Official Language Conference organized by the Department of Official Language on the occasion of Hindi Diwas?

national_questions.qe: Which country officially announced its decision to join the India-led Coalition for Disaster Resilient Infrastructure (CDRI) on the sidelines of the 18th BRICS Summit?

national_questions.qe: Which Union Minister addressed the BRICS Women‑Led Development Conference and emphasized easing credit access for women entrepreneurs?
national_questions.qh: ब्रिक्स महिला‑नेतृत्व विकास सम्मेलन में कौन से केंद्रीय मंत्री ने महिलाओं के उद्यमियों के लिए क्रेडिट तक पहुँच आसान करने पर ज़ोर दिया?

national_questions.qe: Which private partnership built India’s first orbital data‑centre satellite?
national_questions.qh: कौन सा निजी साझेदारी भारत का पहला कक्षा डेटा‑सेंटर उपग्रह बनाता है?

national_questions.qe: What is the primary significance of the EOS‑05 satellite launched on GSLV‑F17?
national_questions.qh: GSLV‑F17 पर लॉन्च किए गए EOS‑05 उपग्रह का मुख्य महत्व क्या है?
oe: It is India’s first lunar mission
It is India’s first geosynchronous Earth‑observation imaging satellite
It is the lightest payload ever launched by a GSLV
It is a communication satellite for TV broadcast
oh: यह भारत का पहला चंद्र मिशन है
यह भारत का पहला भू‑स्थिर पृथ्वी‑पर्यवेक्षण इमेजिंग उपग्रह है
यह GSLV द्वारा लॉन्च किया गया सबसे हल्का पेलोड है
यह टेलीविजन प्रसारण के लिए संचार उपग्रह है
national_questions.e:

• Option A is Incorrect because the mission is not a lunar mission; India’s lunar missions are Chandrayaan series.
• Option C is Incorrect because EOS‑05 is the heaviest, not the lightest, payload ever launched by a GSLV.
• Option D is Incorrect because EOS‑05 is an Earth‑observation imaging satellite, not a TV broadcast communication satellite.

national_questions.qe: Which scheme of the Ministry of Law and Justice is aimed at delivering Tele‑Law services through Common Service Centres and Village Level Entrepreneurs?

national_questions.e:

national_questions.qe: The 'Pension Sakhis' initiative leverages which existing rural livelihood mission?
national_questions.qh: 'पेंशन साखी' पहल किस मौजूदा ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन का उपयोग करती है?

Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY‑NRLM)

national_questions.qe: What is the Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) applicable to Person-to-Merchant (P2M) UPI transactions exceeding ₹2,000 as per the revised framework?

• Option D is Incorrect because Power Grid Corporation of India is engaged in power transmission rather than thermal power generation.

bihar_questions.qe: According to the planned proposal for the high-speed rail corridor connecting Delhi to Patna, what is the estimated total length of this bullet train route?
bihar_questions.qh: दिल्ली से पटना को जोड़ने के लिए प्रस्तावित उच्च गति रेल (बुलेट ट्रेन) गलियारे की अनुमानित कुल लंबाई कितनी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the proposed Delhi-Patna high-speed bullet train corridor spans approximately 1,170 km, aiming to reduce travel time between Delhi and Patna to around 4.5 hours.
• Option A is Incorrect because 945 km refers to the distance of the Delhi-Varanasi section of the corridor.
• Option B is Incorrect because 1,050 km is an arbitrary distance not associated with this project.
• Option D is Incorrect because 1,350 km exceeds the total route length planned for the Delhi-Patna alignment.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which central mission has Bihar identified over 8 lakh manuscripts for digitisation?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार ने 8 लाख से अधिक पांडुलिपियों के डिजिटलीकरण के लिए किस केंद्रीय मिशन के तहत पहचान की है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the manuscript digitisation drive is being executed under the centrally sponsored Gyan Bharatam Mission with Rs 6.23 crore approval.
• Option B is Incorrect because Digital India focuses on broader digital infrastructure, not specifically manuscript preservation.
• Option C is Incorrect as the National Mission on Manuscripts is a separate scheme not mentioned in the Bihar announcement.
• Option D is Incorrect; Swachh Bharat deals with sanitation, unrelated to manuscript digitisation.

bihar_questions.qe: The 'Jaanch evam Upchar, Chikitsa Aapke Dwar' campaign in Bihar aims to screen approximately how many people?
bihar_questions.qh: 'जाँच एवं उपचार, चिकित्सा आपके द्वार' अभियान में बिहार लगभग कितने लोगों की स्क्रीनिंग करने का लक्ष्य रख रहा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the campaign, running from 2 Sept 2026 to 30 Nov 2026, targets around 6 crore individuals aged 30 years and above.
• Option A is Incorrect; the target is far higher than 2 crore.
• Option C is Incorrect; 8 crore exceeds the announced figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; 10 crore is not mentioned in the official rollout.

bihar_questions.qe: The scheme announced by Bihar Power Minister to provide free rooftop solar systems to BPL families offers what capacity per household?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार के पावर मंत्री द्वारा बीपीएल परिवारों को मुफ्त रूफटॉप सोलर सिस्टम देने वाले योजना में प्रत्येक घर को कितनी क्षमता दी जाएगी?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the announced free rooftop solar scheme provides a 1.1 kW system to each of the 2.5 lakh BPL households.
• Option A is Incorrect; 0.5 kW is half of the actual capacity.
• Option B is Incorrect; 0.75 kW is not the figure disclosed.
• Option D is Incorrect; 2 kW exceeds the scheme’s specification.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the liberalized trade policy regulations introduced to boost agricultural exports, into which category were specified wheat varieties, atta, maida, and semolina placed?
bihar_questions.qh: कृषि निर्यात को बढ़ावा देने के लिए लागू किए गए उदारीकृत व्यापार नीति नियमों के तहत, निर्दिष्ट गेहूं किस्मों, आटा, मैदा और सूजी को किस श्रेणी में रखा गया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Government of India liberalized wheat export regulations by shifting specified wheat varieties, atta, maida, and semolina from 'Prohibited' to 'Free' to capitalize on a record wheat output of 121 MMT.
• Option A is Incorrect because 'Restricted' requires specific government licensing, which is not the new classification.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'Prohibited' was the previous regulatory status prior to this policy relaxation.
• Option D is Incorrect because exports are no longer restricted exclusively through State Trading Enterprises.

bihar_questions.qe: Which financial institution signed an MoU worth ₹25,000 crore with the Bihar Government to finance industrial infrastructure and land acquisition through the state's Infrastructure Development Authority?
bihar_questions.qh: किस वित्तीय संस्थान ने राज्य के ढांचागत विकास प्राधिकरण के माध्यम से औद्योगिक बुनियादी ढांचे और भूमि अधिग्रहण को वित्तपोषित करने के लिए बिहार सरकार के साथ ₹25,000 करोड़ के समझौता ज्ञापन पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Housing & Urban Development Corporation (HUDCO) signed a ₹25,000 crore MoU with the Bihar Government to provide term loans over five years for industrial infrastructure and land acquisition through the Infrastructure Development Authority (IDA).
• Option A is Incorrect because NABARD primarily finances rural infrastructure and agriculture projects.
• Option B is Incorrect because Power Finance Corporation (PFC) provides funding specifically for power sector infrastructure.
• Option D is Incorrect because REC Limited focuses on power distribution, generation, and transmission financing.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which section of the Indian Nursing Council Act, 1947 did the Indian Nursing Council withdraw recognition from 40 nursing institutions in Bihar due to infrastructure deficiencies?
bihar_questions.qh: भारतीय नर्सिंग परिषद (INC) ने बुनियादी ढांचे की कमियों के कारण बिहार के 40 नर्सिंग संस्थानों की मान्यता भारतीय नर्सिंग परिषद अधिनियम, 1947 की किस धारा के तहत वापस ली?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Indian Nursing Council (INC) invoked Section 14 of the INC Act, 1947 to withdraw recognition from 40 government and private nursing colleges in Bihar due to deficiencies in faculty and infrastructure.
• Option A is Incorrect because Section 10 relates to the recognition of qualifications granted by nursing institutions in India.
• Option B is Incorrect because Section 12 pertains to the inspection of nursing examinations and training institutions.
• Option C is Incorrect because Section 18 deals with the general power to make regulations under the Act.

bihar_questions.qe: Which central sector sub-scheme under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) offers a direct premium incentive to promote aquaculture insurance coverage for fish farmers?
bihar_questions.qh: प्रधानमंत्री मत्स्य संपदा योजना (PMMSY) के तहत कौन सी केंद्रीय क्षेत्र की उप-योजना मत्स्य पालकों के लिए एक्वाकल्चर बीमा कवरेज को बढ़ावा देने हेतु सीधा प्रीमियम प्रोत्साहन प्रदान करती है?
oe: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Sah-Yojana (PM-MKSSY) is a Central Sector Sub-scheme under PMMSY with an outlay of ₹6,000 crore, offering a 40% one-time premium incentive (up to 50% for SC/ST/women) to encourage aquaculture insurance against natural disasters.
• Option B is Incorrect because 'Pradhan Mantri Matsya Bima Mission' is a non-existent initiative name created as a distractor.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'National Aquaculture Risk Management Scheme' is not the designated sub-scheme under PMMSY.
• Option D is Incorrect because 'Pradhan Mantri Jal Kranti Yojana' relates to general water conservation campaigns, not aquaculture insurance.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which scheme launched in 2023 is the Government of India constructing decentralized godowns at the Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) level to reduce post-harvest losses?
bihar_questions.qh: वर्ष 2023 में शुरू की गई किस योजना के तहत भारत सरकार फसल कटाई के बाद के नुकसान को कम करने के लिए प्राथमिक कृषि ऋण समितियों (PACS) स्तर पर विकेंद्रीकृत गोदामों का निर्माण कर रही है?
oe: Decentralised Grain Storage Plan in Cooperative Sector
oh: सहकारिता क्षेत्र में विकेंद्रीकृत अनाज भंडारण योजना
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the 'Decentralised Grain Storage Plan in Cooperative Sector' was launched in 2023 to create local storage capacity at Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), preventing distress sales by farmers and cutting post-harvest losses.
• Option A is Incorrect because PM Kisan SAMPADA Scheme focuses on food processing infrastructure rather than PACS-level cooperative grain storage godowns.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'National Agri-Warehouse Infrastructure Scheme' is a non-existent scheme name used as a distractor.
• Option D is Incorrect because 'Pradhan Mantri Kisan Bhandaran Yojana' is not the formal title of the cooperative storage initiative.

bihar_questions.qe: Which Union Ministry is the nodal authority for implementing the scheme to establish 6,000 MTPA capacity integrated Rare Earth Permanent Magnet (REPM) manufacturing facilities in India?
bihar_questions.qh: भारत में 6,000 मीट्रिक टन प्रति वर्ष (MTPA) क्षमता वाली एकीकृत दुर्लभ मृदा स्थायी चुंबक (REPM) निर्माण सुविधाओं की स्थापना योजना को लागू करने वाला नोडल केंद्रीय मंत्रालय कौन सा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Ministry of Heavy Industries is the nodal ministry overseeing the REPM manufacturing scheme, aiming to set up 6,000 MTPA of integrated capacity from Neodymium-Praseodymium (NdPr) oxide to finished magnets.
• Option A is Incorrect because while the Ministry of Mines oversees raw mineral extraction, the manufacturing incentive scheme for REPM is administered by Heavy Industries.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Ministry of Power handles grid infrastructure and power generation, not magnet manufacturing supply chains.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Ministry of Science and Technology handles R&D policy rather than industrial manufacturing incentive schemes for REPM.

bihar_questions.qe: Under which section of the Delhi Special Police Establishment (DSPE) Act, 1946 did the Bihar Home Department issue a notification requiring prior CBI approval for investigations of state officials?
bihar_questions.qh: दिल्ली विशेष पुलिस प्रतिष्ठान (DSPE) अधिनियम, 1946 के किस धारा के तहत बिहार गृह विभाग ने राज्य अधिकारियों के खिलाफ CBI जांच से पहले अनुमति माँगने का नोटिफिकेशन जारी किया?
bihar_questions.e: • Option A is Correct because the notification explicitly cites Section 6 of the DSPE Act, 1946 for prior approval. • Option B is Incorrect as Section 7 deals with appointment of officers, not prior approval. • Option C is Incorrect; Section 8 pertains to powers of the Director, not state‑level consent. • Option D is Incorrect; Section 9 relates to removal of officers, unrelated to the notification.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the name of the university Bihar announced to set up for the capacity development of teachers?
bihar_questions.qh: शिक्षकों की क्षमता विकास के लिए बिहार ने स्थापित करने की घोषणा की गई विश्वविद्यालय का नाम क्या है?
bihar_questions.e: • Option B is Correct because the state plan specifically mentions a dedicated 'Teacher Training University' for teacher capacity development. • Option A is Incorrect; no such university was announced in this context. • Option C is Incorrect; the name does not match the announced entity. • Option D is Incorrect; it is not the name used in the announcement.

bihar_questions.qe: Which Indian minister highlighted India as a global manufacturing and innovation hub during the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors meeting?
bihar_questions.qh: G20 वित्त मंत्रियों और केंद्रीय बैंक गवर्नरों की बैठक के दौरान भारत को वैश्विक विनिर्माण और नवाचार केंद्र के रूप में उजागर करने वाले भारतीय मंत्री कौन थे?
bihar_questions.e: • Option C is Correct because Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, on the sidelines of the G20 FMCBG meeting, pitched India as a global manufacturing and innovation hub. • Option A is Incorrect; the Commerce Minister did not make this specific statement. • Option B is Incorrect; the External Affairs Minister was not the speaker in this context. • Option D is Incorrect; the Industry Minister was not quoted for this message.

bihar_questions.qe: Which premier Indian institution has patented a chemical-free antibacterial surface utilizing nanoscale 'nanograss' structures to fight Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)?
bihar_questions.qh: एंटीमाइक्रोबियल प्रतिरोध (AMR) से निपटने के लिए किस प्रमुख भारतीय संस्थान ने नैनोस्केल 'नैनोग्रास' संरचनाओं का उपयोग करने वाली रसायन-मुक्त जीवाणुरोधी सतह का पेटेंट कराया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because researchers at IIT Madras patented a purely mechanical, chemical-free antibacterial surface using nanoscale 'nanograss' structures on implant-grade silicone via Reactive Ion Etching to physically rupture bacterial cell walls.
• Option A is Incorrect because IIT Bombay is not associated with this specific nanograss patent for AMR prevention.
• Option C is Incorrect because IIT Delhi did not lead this mechanical antimicrobial surface innovation.
• Option D is Incorrect because IIT Kharagpur was not involved in developing this patent.

bihar_questions.qe: In which two districts of Bihar did the National Medical Commission (NMC) approve the setup of new Government Medical Colleges for the 2026-27 session?
bihar_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय चिकित्सा आयोग (NMC) ने सत्र 2026-27 के लिए बिहार के किन दो जिलों में नए सरकारी मेडिकल कॉलेजों की स्थापना को मंजूरी दी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the National Medical Commission (NMC) issued Letters of Permission (LoPs) for Government Medical College in Chhapra (Saran) and Ram Janki Medical College in Samastipur.
• Option B is Incorrect because Muzaffarpur and Darbhanga already have existing historical medical colleges (SKMCH and DMCH).
• Option C is Incorrect because Bhagalpur and Purnea were not the districts approved under this specific decision.
• Option D is Incorrect because Gaya and West Champaran host older medical colleges (ANMMCH and GMC Bettiah).

bihar_questions.qe: Which agency is the executing authority for the proposed 1,170 km long Delhi-Patna High-Speed Rail Corridor designed for speeds up to 350 km/h?
bihar_questions.qh: 350 किमी/घंटा तक की डिज़ाइन गति के लिए प्रस्तावित 1,170 किमी लंबे दिल्ली-पटना हाई-स्पीड रेल कॉरिडोर की कार्यान्वयन एजेंसी कौन-सी है?
oe: National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL)
Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India (DFCCIL)
oh: नेशनल हाई स्पीड रेल कॉर्पोरेशन लिमिटेड (NHSRCL)
डेडि़केटेड फ्रेट कॉरिडोर कॉर्पोरेशन ऑफ इंडिया (DFCCIL)
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the National High Speed Rail Corporation Limited (NHSRCL) is the designated executing agency for the 1,170 km Delhi-Uttar Pradesh-Bihar High-Speed Rail Corridor aimed at cutting Delhi-Patna travel time to 4.5 hours.
• Option A is Incorrect because IRCON primarily executes general railway infrastructure and electrification projects.
• Option B is Incorrect because RVNL handles conventional rail connectivity line expansions.
• Option D is Incorrect because DFCCIL manages dedicated freight networks, not passenger bullet train corridors.

bihar_questions.qe: The Valmikinagar Barrage located in Bihar regulates water flow and flood surges primarily originating from which major river system flowing from Nepal?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में स्थित वाल्मीकिनगर बैराज मुख्य रूप से नेपाल से निकलने वाली किस नदी प्रणाली के जल प्रवाह और बाढ़ को नियंत्रित करता है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the 60-year-old Gandak Barrage at Valmikinagar regulates the water surges originating in Nepal from the Trishuli and Narayani rivers, which merge to form the Gandak River entering North Bihar.
• Option A is Incorrect because the Kosi river flows downstream through the Bhimnagar Barrage in Supaul district.
• Option B is Incorrect because the Mahananda river drains eastern Bihar and parts of West Bengal.
• Option C is Incorrect because Bagmati river originates near Kathmandu and enters Bihar in Sitamarhi district separately.

bihar_questions.qe: In which year was Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) elevated to Navratna CPSE status?
bihar_questions.qh: रेल विकास निगम लिमिटेड (RVNL) को Navratna CPSE दर्जा किस वर्ष मिला?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because RVNL was granted Navratna CPSE status in 2023 as per the Ministry of Railways announcement.
• Option B is Incorrect because 2013 is the year RVNL attained Category‑I Mini‑Ratna status, not Navratna.
• Option C is Incorrect because 2020 did not witness any change in RVNL’s CPSE classification.
• Option D is Incorrect because the Navratna elevation occurred earlier, in 2023.

bihar_questions.qe: According to the WHO Global TB Report 2025, what was the percentage reduction in India's TB incidence between 2015 and 2024?
bihar_questions.qh: WHO Global TB Report 2025 के अनुसार 2015‑2024 में भारत में टीबी की घटना में प्रतिशत कमी क्या थी?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the report states a 21% decline in TB incidence from 237 to 187 cases per lakh population.
• Option A is Incorrect; the reduction was higher than 15%.
• Option C is Incorrect; 27% exceeds the reported figure.
• Option D is Incorrect; 33% is not supported by the WHO data.

bihar_questions.qe: The 'India Valve Registry' inaugurated by Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan in 2026 is primarily intended to collect what type of data?
bihar_questions.qh: वाइस प्रेसिडेंट सी.पी. राधाकृष्णन द्वारा 2026 में उद्घाटित 'इंडिया वैवल रेजिस्ट्री' मुख्यतः किस प्रकार का डेटा एकत्र करेगी?
oe: De‑identified clinical data on heart valve interventions
Real‑time imaging data from operating theatres
oh: हृदय वाल्व हस्तक्षेपों पर पहचान रहित क्लिनिकल डेटा
ऑपरेटिंग थिएटर से रीयल‑टाइम इमेजिंग डेटा
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the registry is a multicentre national database that records de‑identified clinical information on valve procedures.
• Option A is Incorrect; genetic data is not within the registry’s scope.
• Option B is Incorrect; financial data of hospitals is not collected.
• Option D is Incorrect; real‑time imaging is not the primary data type for the registry.

bihar_questions.qe: The rules being fast‑tracked under the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 aim to regulate which sector?
bihar_questions.qh: भारतीय विमानन अधिनियम, 2024 के तहत तेज़ी से तैयार किए जा रहे नियम किस क्षेत्र को नियंत्रित करेंगे?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 pertains to civil aviation and the Supreme Court hearing concerned airfare regulation.
• Option A is Incorrect; maritime shipping is governed by separate legislation.
• Option B is Incorrect; railway freight falls under the Ministry of Railways.
• Option C is Incorrect; telecommunications are regulated by the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India, not the aviation act.

bihar_questions.qe: Which ministry is the nodal ministry for India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) that was recognised by the United Kingdom under its CBAM framework?
bihar_questions.qh: यूनाइटेड किंगडम द्वारा अपने CBAM ढाँचे के तहत भारत के कार्बन क्रेडिट ट्रेडिंग स्कीम (CCTS) को मान्यता मिलने पर इसका मुख्य मंत्रालय कौन सा है?
oe: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
oh: पर्यावरण, वन और जलवायु परिवर्तन मंत्रालय
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme is managed by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency, which functions under the Ministry of Power.
• Option A is Incorrect because the scheme is not under the Environment Ministry.
• Option C is Incorrect because commerce ministry does not administer CCTS.
• Option D is Incorrect because finance ministry is not the nodal agency for CCTS.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the subsidy range announced by the Bihar Agriculture Department for eligible sugarcane machinery?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार कृषि विभाग द्वारा पात्र शुगरकेन मशीनरी के लिये घोषित सब्सिडी की सीमा क्या है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because the scheme provides a subsidy of 40%‑50% on 44 types of sugarcane machinery for 3,173 farmers.
• Option A is Incorrect as the subsidy is far higher than 10‑20%.
• Option B is Incorrect because the announced range does not start at 20%.
• Option C is Incorrect; the subsidy exceeds 30%.

bihar_questions.qe: According to the WHO Global TB Report 2025, by what percentage did India's TB incidence decline between 2015 and 2024?
bihar_questions.qh: WHO ग्लोबल टीबी रिपोर्ट 2025 के अनुसार 2015‑2024 के बीच भारत में टीबी की घटना में कितनी प्रतिशत गिरावट आई?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because incidence fell from 237 to 187 cases per lakh population – a 21% decline.
• Option B is Incorrect; the decline is higher than 15%.
• Option C is Incorrect; the decline exceeds 10%.
• Option D is Incorrect; the reduction is far above 5%.

bihar_questions.qe: As of August 2026, what is the total balance in all PM Jan Dhan Yojana accounts combined?
bihar_questions.qh: अगस्त 2026 तक सभी पीएम जन धन योजना खातों में कुल जमा राशि कितनी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because Finance Ministry RTI data shows a combined balance exceeding ₹3.15 lakh crore.
• Option A is Incorrect; the balance is higher than ₹2.5 lakh crore.
• Option B is Incorrect; the figure is slightly above ₹3.0 lakh crore.
• Option D is Incorrect; the balance does not reach ₹3.5 lakh crore.

bihar_questions.qe: Which historical location in Bihar is being developed into a major eco-tourism hub featuring sites such as Maya Sarovar, Muchalinda Sarovar, and Dungeshwari hills?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार के किस ऐतिहासिक स्थान को माया सरोवर, मुचलिंद सरोवर और डुंगेश्वरी पहाड़ियों जैसे स्थलों के साथ एक प्रमुख इको-टूरिज्म हब के रूप में विकसित किया जा रहा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: The Environment, Forest and Climate Change Department of Bihar is developing Bodh Gaya into a major eco-tourism hub, featuring nature walks, trekking, and bird-watching around Maya Sarovar, Muchalinda Sarovar, and Dungeshwari hills.
• Option B is Incorrect: Rajgir is famous for its glass bridge and nature safari, but the targeted sarovars and Dungeshwari area are located in Bodh Gaya.
• Option C is Incorrect: Vaishali is an ancient Buddhist and Jain pilgrimage site, not the location of Maya and Muchalinda Sarovars.
• Option D is Incorrect: Valmiki Nagar is known for Bihar's only Tiger Reserve, located in West Champaran.

bihar_questions.qe: With which organization did the Industries Department of Bihar sign an MoU to establish an integrated agri-food and food processing cluster in the state?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार के उद्योग विभाग ने राज्य में एक एकीकृत कृषि-खाद्य और खाद्य प्रसंस्करण क्लस्टर स्थापित करने के लिए किस संगठन के साथ एक समझौता ज्ञापन (MoU) पर हस्ताक्षर किए?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: The Industries Department of Bihar signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with AIM Global Foundation at the AIM Congress in Dubai to set up an integrated agri-food and food processing cluster with Gulf region investment support.
• Option A is Incorrect: World Economic Forum is an international non-profit organization based in Switzerland and was not a party to this agreement.
• Option C is Incorrect: US-India Strategic Partnership Forum focuses on US-India commercial ties, whereas this agreement was signed in Dubai with Gulf backing.
• Option D is Incorrect: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority is a sovereign wealth fund, not the signing foundation for this initiative.

bihar_questions.qe: At which ghat in Patna did the Ganga River breach its previous historical peak flood level record by reaching 50.57 meters?
bihar_questions.qh: पटना के किस घाट पर गंगा नदी ने 50.57 मीटर के जलस्तर को छूकर अपने पिछले सर्वकालिक ऐतिहासिक उच्चतम बाढ़ स्तर के रिकॉर्ड को तोड़ दिया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: The Ganga River breached its previous all-time maximum flood level record of 50.52 meters (set in August 2016) by reaching 50.57 meters at Gandhi Ghat in Patna.
• Option A is Incorrect: Collectorate Ghat is a key riverfront in Patna, but the specific historic gauge record was set at Gandhi Ghat.
• Option B is Incorrect: Bhadra Ghat recorded high water levels, but the historic record peak was registered at Gandhi Ghat.
• Option D is Incorrect: Digha Ghat serves as a major hydrological reading station in western Patna, but was not where the record peak of 50.57 meters occurred.

bihar_questions.qe: According to the National Family Health Survey-6 (NFHS-6) data for Bihar, what was the recorded rate of institutional deliveries in the state?
bihar_questions.qh: राष्ट्रीय परिवार स्वास्थ्य सर्वेक्षण-6 (NFHS-6) के आंकड़ों के अनुसार, बिहार में संस्थागत प्रसव (Institutional Deliveries) की दर कितनी दर्ज की गई?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: According to NFHS-6 data, institutional deliveries in Bihar increased significantly from 76.2% to 81.1%, with government hospitals accounting for 57.5% of total deliveries.
• Option A is Incorrect: 63.9% represents the percentage of pregnant women receiving first-trimester Antenatal Care (ANC) coverage in Bihar.
• Option B is Incorrect: 69.9% represents postnatal care coverage for mothers within two days of delivery.
• Option C is Incorrect: 76.2% was the institutional delivery rate recorded previously in NFHS-5.

bihar_questions.qe: With which technology organization has the State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT), Bihar partnered to train school teachers in Artificial Intelligence (AI) skills?
bihar_questions.qh: राज्य शिक्षा शोध एवं प्रशिक्षण परिषद (SCERT), बिहार ने स्कूली शिक्षकों को आर्टिफ़िशियल इंटेलिजेंस (AI) कौशल में प्रशिक्षित करने के लिए किस प्रौद्योगिकी संस्थान के साथ समझौता किया है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because SCERT Bihar partnered with Google India to sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) aimed at training school teachers in Artificial Intelligence (AI) skills across state schools and Kasturba Gandhi Residential Girls' Schools.
• Option A is Incorrect because Microsoft India is not the executing partner for this teacher AI capacity-building initiative.
• Option C is Incorrect because IBM India is not associated with this specific SCERT Bihar agreement.
• Option D is Incorrect because Meta India is not involved in this education sector program.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the revised social security pension schemes announced by the Bihar Department of Social Welfare, what is the enhanced monthly pension amount provided to eligible beneficiaries?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार समाज कल्याण विभाग द्वारा घोषित संशोधित सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन योजनाओं के तहत पात्र लाभार्थियों को प्रदान की जाने वाली अद्यतन मासिक पेंशन राशि क्या है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Bihar Department of Social Welfare increased the social security pension from ₹400 to ₹1,100 per month across Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojana, Laxmibai Samajik Suraksha Pension Yojana, and disability pension schemes.
• Option A is Incorrect because ₹800 is not the updated pension figure.
• Option B is Incorrect because ₹1,000 per month was not the revised statutory rate.
• Option D is Incorrect because ₹1,500 exceeds the newly fixed pension amount.

bihar_questions.qe: The Airports Authority of India (AAI) has issued a tender for the development and infrastructure upgrade of which airport to boost regional air connectivity in the Kosi region of Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: भारतीय विमानपत्तन प्राधिकरण (AAI) ने बिहार के कोसी क्षेत्र में क्षेत्रीय हवाई संपर्क को बढ़ावा देने के लिए किस हवाई अड्डे के विकास और बुनियादी ढांचे के उन्नयन हेतु निविदा जारी की है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Airports Authority of India (AAI) floated a ₹42.52 crore tender for the infrastructure upgrade of Saharsa Airport in North Bihar's Kosi division.
• Option B is Incorrect because Purnea Airport is located in the Seemanchal region, not the Kosi region.
• Option C is Incorrect because Raxaul Airport is located near the Nepal border in East Champaran.
• Option D is Incorrect because Darbhanga Airport is an operational operational commercial airport under the UDAN scheme in Mithila region.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the approved annual mining capacity of the quartzite block allotted to Monolithisch India in Nawada district, Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार के नवादा जिले में मोनोलिथिक इंडिया को आवंटित क्वार्ट्जाइट ब्लॉक की स्वीकृत वार्षिक खनन क्षमता कितनी मीट्रिक टन है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the e‑auction notice specifies an approved annual mining capacity of 7,10,000 MT for the quartzite block, amounting to 35.5 lakh MT over the 5‑year lease.
• Option B is Incorrect as the capacity mentioned is lower than the sanctioned figure.
• Option C is Incorrect; 8,50,000 MT is not cited in the lease documents.
• Option D is Incorrect; 10,00,000 MT exceeds the approved limit.

bihar_questions.qe: Under the RESCO model launched by BREDA, what is the total capacity targeted for rooftop solar installations on government buildings in Bihar?
bihar_questions.qh: बीआरईडीए द्वारा आरईएससीओ मॉडल के तहत सरकारी इमारतों पर स्थापित करने के लिए लक्ष्यित रूफटॉप सोलर क्षमता कितने मेगावॉट है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because BREDA’s tender explicitly seeks to empanel developers for 500 MW of grid‑connected rooftop solar on government premises.
• Option A is Incorrect; 250 MW is half of the announced target.
• Option C is Incorrect; 750 MW exceeds the stated requirement.
• Option D is Incorrect; 1000 MW is double the approved capacity.

bihar_questions.qe: According to NFHS‑6, which two Indian states have a Total Fertility Rate (TFR) above the replacement level of 2.1?
bihar_questions.qh: एनएफएचएस-6 के अनुसार, कौन-से दो राज्य कुल प्रजनन दर (TFR) 2.1 से अधिक है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the NFHS‑6 report states that only Bihar and Meghalaya have TFR values (above 2.1) exceeding the replacement level.
• Option A is Incorrect; Rajasthan’s TFR is below 2.1.
• Option B is Incorrect; Uttar Pradesh’s TFR is also below replacement level.
• Option D is Incorrect; Assam’s TFR is below 2.1 while Meghalaya alone is above it.

bihar_questions.qe: Which global institution has been selected by the Bihar state government to send 100 university professors for advanced capacity-building training?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार राज्य सरकार द्वारा 100 विश्वविद्यालय प्रोफेसरों को उन्नत क्षमता-निर्माण प्रशिक्षण के लिए किस वैश्विक संस्थान में भेजने की घोषणा की गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Bihar state government announced an initiative to select and send 100 university professors for advanced capacity-building training at Oxford University and other leading global institutions.
• Option B is Incorrect because Harvard University was not the global institution designated for this capacity-building program.
• Option C is Incorrect because Cambridge University was not selected as the primary institution for this training module.
• Option D is Incorrect because Stanford University is not part of this faculty initiative announced by the state government.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the name of the month-long public outreach campaign launched by the Bihar state government across all districts from September 17 to October 17, 2026?
bihar_questions.qh: 17 सितंबर से 17 अक्टूबर 2026 तक बिहार सरकार द्वारा सभी जिलों में शुरू किए गए महीने भर लंबे जन अभियान का क्या नाम है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the Bihar state government launched the month-long 'Seva Sankalp Abhiyan' across all 38 districts, comprising 13 key components including community mobilization, school infrastructure improvement, and 'Viksit Bharat 2047' pledges.
• Option A is Incorrect because 'Viksit Bihar Abhiyan' is not the designated title of this multi-sectoral campaign.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'Jan Adhikar Yatra' is an unrelated political term and not the government outreach campaign.
• Option D is Incorrect because 'Bihar Gaurav Abhiyan' is not the official name of this drive.

bihar_questions.qe: According to the recent decision by the Bihar state government, on which fixed date of every month will social security pensions be disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार राज्य सरकार के हालिया निर्णय के अनुसार, पात्र लाभार्थियों को प्रत्यक्ष लाभ अंतरण (DBT) के माध्यम से सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन प्रत्येक माह की किस निश्चित तिथि को हस्तांतरित की जाएगी?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Bihar state government fixed the 10th of every month for transferring social security pensions via DBT, disbursing ₹1,233.87 crore to over 105 lakh beneficiaries.
• Option A is Incorrect because the 1st of the month is not the designated fixed schedule for Bihar's social security DBT pension transfers.
• Option B is Incorrect because the 5th of the month was not selected as the official monthly payment date.
• Option D is Incorrect because the 15th of the month is not the scheduled DBT transfer date.

bihar_questions.qe: Through which major cross-border transmission line in Bihar has the Ministry of Power approved the emergency export of electricity to Nepal to assist following severe flood damage?
bihar_questions.qh: हाल ही में विद्युत मंत्रालय द्वारा बाढ़ से प्रभावित नेपाल को आपातकालीन बिजली निर्यात के लिए बिहार की किस प्रमुख सीमा पार पारेषण (ट्रान्समिशन) लाइन के माध्यम से अनुमति प्रदान की गई है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the Ministry of Power approved the export of up to 654 MW of electricity to Nepal via the Muzaffarpur-Dhalkebar and Tanakpur-Mahendranagar transmission lines to help Nepal manage power shortages caused by severe flood damage.
• Option B is Incorrect because Katihar-Kakarbhitta is not the designated operational line for this approved emergency power transfer.
• Option C is Incorrect because the Gorakhpur-Bhutwal transmission line is located in Uttar Pradesh, not Bihar.
• Option D is Incorrect because Sitamarhi-Jalpath is a fictional transmission line route.

bihar_questions.qe: According to recent official announcements regarding higher education funding in Bihar, what proportion of the state's total annual budget is allocated to the education sector?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार में उच्च शिक्षा और बजटीय आवंटन के संदर्भ में, राज्य के कुल वार्षिक बजट का कितना प्रतिशत भाग शिक्षा क्षेत्र पर खर्च किया जा रहा है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct because the state government of Bihar allocates over 21% of its total annual state budget to the education sector, spanning primary, secondary, and higher education infrastructure.
• Option A is Incorrect as 12% is significantly below Bihar's recorded expenditure proportion for education.
• Option C is Incorrect because 15% does not reflect the accurate state expenditure benchmark.
• Option D is Incorrect because 28% exceeds the official budgetary proportion committed by the state.

bihar_questions.qe: In which city was the Annual Investment Meeting (AIM) Congress held in September 2026, where a Bihar state delegation presented investment opportunities to global investors?
bihar_questions.qh: सितंबर 2026 में 'एनुअल इन्वेस्टमेंट मीटिंग (AIM) कांग्रेस' का आयोजन किस शहर में किया गया, जहाँ बिहार के एक प्रतिनिधिमंडल ने वैश्विक निवेशकों के समक्ष राज्य की निवेश संभावनाओं को प्रदर्शित किया?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because the Annual Investment Meeting (AIM) Congress took place in Dubai, UAE, where a Bihar official delegation pitched state investment potential in infrastructure, connectivity, and power.
• Option A is Incorrect because Riyadh, Saudi Arabia was not the host city for the AIM Congress.
• Option B is Incorrect as Doha, Qatar did not host this event.
• Option D is Incorrect because Abu Dhabi was not the chosen venue city for the AIM Congress.

bihar_questions.qe: Under Bihar's Fourth Agriculture Road Map, registered farmers can avail government subsidy for drone-based crop spraying up to a maximum limit of how many acres per crop season?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार के चौथे कृषि रोड मैप के तहत, पंजीकृत किसान प्रति फसल सीजन में अधिकतम कितने एकड़ तक ड्रोन आधारित फसल छिड़काव पर सरकारी सब्सिडी प्राप्त कर सकते हैं?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct because under Bihar's Fourth Agriculture Road Map and Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana, registered farmers on the DBT portal can avail government subsidies for drone spraying of liquid fertilizers and pesticides up to 15 acres per crop season.
• Option A is Incorrect because 5 acres is below the prescribed ceiling under this scheme.
• Option B is Incorrect because 10 acres is not the sanctioned upper limit per farmer per crop season.
• Option D is Incorrect because 20 acres exceeds the permissible subsidized acreage limit.

bihar_questions.qe: The Bihar government opened 211 government degree colleges in a single day to cover all blocks under which resolution of the Saat Nischay-3 initiative?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार सरकार ने सात निश्चय-3 के किस संकल्प के तहत राज्य के सभी प्रखंडों को कवर करने के लिए एक ही दिन में 211 सरकारी डिग्री कॉलेज स्थापित किए?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct because the establishment of 211 degree colleges in a single day was executed under the 'Unnat Shiksha, Ujjwal Bhavishya' resolution of Saat Nischay-3, increasing constituent colleges in Bihar from 272 to 483.
• Option B is Incorrect because 'Yuva Shakti, Bihar Ki Pragati' was a component of Saat Nischay-2 focusing on skill development and entrepreneurship.
• Option C is Incorrect because 'Kushal Bihar' focuses primarily on vocational training programs.
• Option D is Incorrect because 'Sashakt Mahila, Samarth Bihar' relates to women's empowerment and economic independence.

bihar_questions.qe: According to rating agency ICRA, how much capital are Indian urban local bodies projected to raise through green municipal bonds between FY 2027 and FY 2030?
bihar_questions.qh: रेटिंग एजेंसी ICRA के अनुसार, भारतीय शहरी स्थानीय निकाय वित्त वर्ष 2027 से वित्त वर्ष 2030 के दौरान ग्रीन म्यूनिसिपल बॉन्ड के माध्यम से कितनी राशि जुटाने का अनुमान लगाते हैं?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct because rating agency ICRA projects civic bodies in India to raise ₹10,000 crore through green municipal bonds over the FY2027-FY2030 period to fund sustainable urban infrastructure.
• Option A is Incorrect because ₹2,500 crore is significantly lower than the projection.
• Option B is Incorrect because ₹5,000 crore accounts for only half of the estimated total issuance volume.
• Option C is Incorrect because ₹7,500 crore is not the figure projected in the ICRA assessment.

bihar_questions.qe: In which landmark public interest litigation case is the Supreme Court of India monitoring the implementation of the Menstrual Hygiene Policy for school-going girls across States and Union Territories?
bihar_questions.qh: किस जनहित याचिका के तहत सर्वोच्च न्यायालय राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में स्कूली छात्राओं के लिए 'मासिक धर्म स्वच्छता नीति' के कार्यान्वयन की निगरानी कर रहा है?
oe: Jaya Thakur v. Union of India & Ors.
Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
S.R. Bommai v. Union of India
oh: जया ठाकुर बनाम भारत संघ एवं अन्य
bihar_questions.e:
• Option A is Correct: The Supreme Court bench examined affidavits in 'Jaya Thakur v. Government of India & Ors.', directing states to ensure strict compliance with the Menstrual Hygiene Policy for schoolgirls in Classes 6 to 12.
• Option B is Incorrect: Vishaka v. State of Rajasthan (1997) pertains to workplace sexual harassment guidelines.
• Option C is Incorrect: Shreya Singhal v. Union of India (2015) struck down Section 66A of the Information Technology Act.
• Option D is Incorrect: S.R. Bommai v. Union of India (1994) dealt with Article 356 and the imposition of President's Rule.

bihar_questions.qe: Which flagship central government scheme launched in 2024 aims to provide free electricity to households by incentivizing residential rooftop solar installations across India?
bihar_questions.qh: वर्ष 2024 में शुरू की गई केंद्र सरकार की कौन सी प्रमुख योजना पूरे भारत में आवासीय रूफटॉप सोलर स्थापना को बढ़ावा देकर परिवारों को मुफ्त बिजली प्रदान करने का लक्ष्य रखती है?
oe: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
oh: पीएम सूर्य घर: मुफ्त बिजली योजना
bihar_questions.e:
• Option B is Correct: The PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana was launched in February 2024 to promote residential rooftop solar installations across India, with total potential estimated at 132 GW by ISMA.
• Option A is Incorrect: PM-KUSUM focuses on solarizing agricultural water pumps and solar power plants for farmers.
• Option C is Incorrect: National Solar Mission is an overarching initiative launched in 2010 under NAPCC.
• Option D is Incorrect: PM-PRANAM aims to reduce the use of chemical fertilizers in agriculture.

bihar_questions.qe: Under Bihar's Fourth Agriculture Roadmap, in which district has the state government approved the establishment of nine jaggery-making units with up to 50% financial subsidy?
bihar_questions.qh: बिहार के चौथे कृषि रोडमैप के तहत, राज्य सरकार ने 50% तक के वित्तीय अनुदान के साथ किस जिले में नौ गुड़ निर्माण इकाइयां स्थापित करने की मंजूरी दी है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option C is Correct: Under the Fourth Agriculture Roadmap and State Jaggery Industry Promotion Programme, Bihar is establishing nine jaggery units in Muzaffarpur district with 50% subsidy on project costs ranging from ₹12 lakh to ₹1 crore.
• Option A is Incorrect: West Champaran is famous for sugarcane production, but the specific 9-unit jaggery initiative under this scheme was designated for Muzaffarpur.
• Option B is Incorrect: Samastipur is a major agricultural hub, but not the targeted district for these nine jaggery units.
• Option D is Incorrect: Rohtas is prominent for paddy and wheat production.

bihar_questions.qe: What is the technical minimum operational capability recommended by the Central Electricity Authority (CEA) for coal-based thermal power plants to ensure grid stability and facilitate renewable energy integration?
bihar_questions.qh: ग्रिड स्थिरता सुनिश्चित करने और नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा एकीकरण को सुगम बनाने के लिए केंद्रीय विद्युत प्राधिकरण (CEA) द्वारा कोयला आधारित तापीय विद्युत संयंत्रों के लिए अनुशंसित तकनीकी न्यूनतम परिचालन क्षमता क्या है?
bihar_questions.e:
• Option D is Correct: Central Electricity Authority (CEA) regulations specify a 40% technical minimum operational capability for coal plants (down from 55%) to allow thermal generators to ramp down output when variable solar and wind power generation peak.
• Option A is Incorrect: 25% is far below current operational limits of conventional coal power boilers.
• Option B is Incorrect: 30% operational level is not the CEA mandated standard.
